rows.text: So... what came up?
It's rare for the conductor to make an announcement.
Are we switching routes again?
What Nameless?
Are we getting new crew mates?
Is this a rare happening?
Who could be this important?
It's been so long. Will we still be able to find them?
Pom-Pom's not here yet?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Pom-Pom knows how to keep people on the edge of their seats.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: *ahem* Apologies for the delay, dear passengers. Something important came up, so I, the conductor, had to spend some time preparing!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Yeah! What was so important?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah! What was so important?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? But I only just finished packing my bags!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I thought everyone knew! Our next destination is the Planet of Festivities, Penacony.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: I know everyone's eager to disembark and get to that famous stellar hotel, but before we set off, I should remind everyone of three things.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: First: Penacony is located in Asdana, a star system brimming with memoria, which has historically been one of the Macro Voids that leaked out from the Memory Zone. Even after eons, the memoria concentration up ahead is above normal levels.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Usually, this wouldn't be a huge problem... but everyone's different, so if you exhibit any signs of dizziness, hallucination, distorted memories or any other symptoms, you should take them seriously!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Second: Penacony is a colony belonging to the Harmony Family — it also marks the first time this Family has extended a public invitation to other factions. Please remember that the Express has been invited as a guest, and that we must adhere to any and all regulations.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Got it! When in Rome, as they say! Don't worry, Conductor, we definitely won't embarrass the Nameless.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Rome? Anyway... Third and final: Rather than being a request... Pom-Pom has a favor to ask of everyone.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: If you could, I hope that while you're all on vacation, you could spare some time to help inquire about a few of the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Allow me to explain.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Just like most of the worlds that the Express calls at, Penacony is one of the stops along the silver tracks. Several millennia ago, it was an IPC frontier prison, and it was the Trailblaze that connected it to thousands of stars.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: During that time, the Astral Express once visited Penacony. As with all meetings, they inevitably lead to goodbyes. As the Express's logs indicate, it seems some passengers decided to call Penacony their permanent home.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Don't worry, just think of it as returning to your hometown. Following the Express's departure, the {RUBY_B#Cancer of All Worlds}Stellarons{RUBY_E#} cut off contact to myriad worlds, and Penacony's ownership switched hands several times.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Why did these Nameless choose to stay here? How did the course of their subsequent lives unfold, and what legacies did they leave behind? Retracing our predecessors' footsteps, that is in itself an adventure, wouldn't you agree?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Even if they left the stars behind them, their Trailblaze would not be over. That's also what the conductor thinks, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: According to the passenger list, the three people who got off were Tiernan, Legwork, and Razalina — the Express's guard, mechanic, and surveyor, respectively. No supplementary details are available.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Just names and occupations? And they don't even sound like their real names either... This will be like looking for a needle in a haystack!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We'll just leave it to the stars of fate. Considering the Nameless' diversity... Perhaps we might even stumble upon their descendants, or, against the slimmest of chances, the very individuals themselves.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We'll conclude today's navigation meeting on this point. There's a bit of time left before we jump. In the meantime, might be a good idea to double-check your bags.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'll broadcast an announcement before we jump!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: How's it going, [Trailblazer]? All packed and ready?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: There probably won't be any surprises happening on Family territory, which is a bit of a shame if you ask me. But hey, it's rare that we can take a break and let loose. Let's enjoy it.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mr. Yang, you look relaxed.
Mr. Yang, you seem disappointed.
Well, adventures are exhilarating, but rest and recuperation is equally important.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Of course not! Adventures are exhilarating, but rest and recuperation is equally important.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Rest and recuperation aside, don't forget Pom-Pom's request. The conductor has done plenty for us, and it's time to return that favor.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you're the picture of calm as always. Meanwhile, March 7th's buzzing around like a kid on a sugar rush.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm excited, too!
Of course, I'm the mature, adult-type.
I trust Penacony won't let you all down.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: A punchline with a straight face — I suppose that's your specialty.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But, regarding The Family's invitation, I do have some details that I wish to discuss with everyone... just not now. Let's enjoy our vacation for now.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you're up? How's your prep going? Welt and Himeko beat us to the punch, but I stuck around for you. Let's get going.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mm... Shall we go meet up with them now?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm ready to go.
Hold on a moment.
Penacony, the Planet of Festivities, the universe's biggest and fanciest amusement park awaits!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You left something behind? Hurry up and go get it, I'll wait here for you!

rows.text: Welcome to a new episode of Interastral Peace Broadcast. We are here to bring you the latest news from across the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Chaos erupted during the Phantasmoon Games, Planarcadia's Elation festival, as the Lord Ravager, Asat Pramad, made his presence known.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Stellaron Hunter Kafka has been spotted in Penacony. Her appearance is potentially connected to the fallen Aeon of Beauty.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Starflux Grand Prix is gearing up to start, with the celebrated singer Robin visiting Astropolis to perform at the opening ceremony.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Significant progress has been made in the Intelligentsia Guild's "Imaginary Wormhole Lane" trial, paving the way for future use in interstellar voyages.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The newly formed celestial body "Amphoreus" is evolving at a steady pace, and all indications suggest a promising developmental path.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Let's take a closer look at the details.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The traditional Phantasmoon Games of Planarcadia, located on Ahatopia, began on schedule but were promptly struck by multiple crises.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: During the event, a string of violent incidents, from consecutive murder cases to the outbreak of an imagenesis plague, swept across Planarcadia, affecting more than 200,000 innocent residents.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: As of the present time, the Lord Ravager Asat Pramad has made a high-profile appearance, forcibly entering the Phantasmoon Games and intensifying the disaster, all while Planarcadia remains unreachable.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Sources report that Pearl of the Strategic Investment Department's Ten Stonehearts has mobilized emergency measures. She is coordinating with the Astral Express, the Xianzhou Alliance, and other allied forces in a tense face-off against Asat Pramad.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: In response, the IPC's key executives are convening an urgent meeting in Astropolis to chart a course for resolving the crisis.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: We will continue to follow the situation closely. Let us hope that Planarcadia weathers the threat of the Destruction and endures through these perilous times.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Last week, the Interastral Peace Corporation was notified by an observant citizen about the suspected presence of a wanted individual in Penacony. Upon investigation, the individual was identified as Kafka, a member of the Stellaron Hunters.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Acting without delay, IPC professionals joined forces with The Family to arrest Kafka, forcing her into tight situations on multiple occasions.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: While Kafka managed to flee, investigations established that she had a Mirror of Transcendence in her possession, though her motives are still unclear.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Mirrors of Transcendence are fragments of the Aeon of Beauty, Idrila's divine form. Among them, the one carried by Kafka is believed to have come from the Agate World, Melustanin.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: With the Stellaron Hunters involved in the fallen Aeon's remains, the question remains: Are they seeking profit, or intending to weaponize the Aeon's power?
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Currently, the IPC is stepping up inquiries throughout the relevant star systems, and we urge citizens to report any information that may assist in safeguarding interstellar order.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Soon, the prestigious Starflux Grand Prix races will kick off at the Interastral Peace Entertainment headquarters, Astropolis. Top racers from across the cosmos are ready to unleash speed, skill, and passion in pursuit of supreme victory.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The beloved star Robin will take the stage at the opening ceremony, lending her voice to the start of the races. Throughout the event, Astropolis will host the Amber Cup Film Festival and a range of entertainment celebrations.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: After years of research, the Imaginary Wormhole Lane technology reached operational stability half a month ago. The experimental vessel Fragrant Shadow successfully completed its first voyage, transporting flowers and plaster statues.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: For a long time, the Imaginary Wormhole Lane remained purely theoretical, until ten years ago when Ms. Yabuli and the Intelligentsia Guild successfully overcame the technological barriers.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Using Imaginary Energy to transcend spatial confines, humanity now prepares to embark on interstellar voyages across unprecedented distances.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Together, we can imagine a future where people across the universe, light-years apart, reach out and greet one another.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The celestial body Amphoreus is experiencing remarkable growth. This is the very world depicted in the best-selling book As I've Written.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Multicellular invertebrate communities are forming across Amphoreus's surface. Enveloped by dense memoria, evolution advances at a pace almost like a time-lapse recording.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Although she declined to appear on camera, recent meetings between Madam Herta and the Intelligentsia Guild confirmed that she fully endorses the scientific assessment: The resurgence of Amphoreus is inevitable.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Amphoreus's present condition aligns with the records Madam Herta gleaned from the Scepter fragments. According to her evolutionary models, the civilization of this world is destined to follow the "final cycle" recorded within the Scepter.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Excitingly, the "final cycle" described by Madam Herta is expected to manifest as a tableau of utmost balance and grandeur.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: With genuine hope and care, the Interastral Peace Corporation will keep Amphoreus under close observation, delivering real-time reports to our audience.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: And this is the end of our broadcast. Please tune in for our next episode. Thank you for listening.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Goodbye.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: In recent developments, the Lord Ravager "Irontomb" — once a scourge upon the universe — has been decisively crushed.

rows.text: In a joint operation spearheaded by the Interastral Peace Corporation and supported by the Astral Express, Xianzhou Alliance, Genius Society, and numerous other forces, the civilizations of the universe have achieved a decisive victory over the Destruction.

rows.text: This marks the fall of yet another Lord Ravager, following the Galaxy Rangers' defeat of "Zulo."
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: With its reach spanning the cosmos, "Irontomb" delivered devastating blows to countless worlds. In response to this catastrophe, the Interastral Peace Corporation took decisive action, overseeing the restoration of all affected planets.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The broad-spectrum vaccine developed by the Technology Department has been confirmed to effectively prevent "Irontomb" infections. For star zones without medical coverage, the IPC will distribute vaccines in phases. Residents are urged to remain calm.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: During the aftermath, a mysterious but benign data stream assisted in purging the remaining virus. On every affected device, it left a single message: "Hello, world."
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation expresses heartfelt thanks to this anonymous protector and salutes all frontline workers for their dedication.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Together, we stand united. As the firm pillar supporting civilized society, the IPC is committed to advancing operations against the Antimatter Legion. Stay tuned for ongoing coverage. We wish for good news ahead.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Now that the Irontomb crisis has subsided, a kindling of civilization, nurtured by the Remembrance, has been lit in the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: According to information provided by the Nameless, IPC representatives have learned that this newborn planet is called "Amphoreus."
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Dr. Veritas Ratio of the Intelligentsia Guild stated that, according to the "Zandar Recurrence Theorem," Amphoreus will inevitably give rise to civilization, and its memoria content will serve as a key foundation for the evolution of that civilization.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Through reverse engineering of the scepter fragments, Genius Society members {RUBY_B#Genius Society #76}Mr. Screwllum{RUBY_E#} and {RUBY_B#Genius Society #83}Madam Herta{RUBY_E#} have successfully replicated a portion of the data.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: This suggests that {RUBY_B#electrical signals}life{RUBY_E#} which once existed in this world may one day be reborn in the future.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The IPC will uphold the principles of the Preservation and provide essential protection and guidance for this planet. The Intelligentsia Guild has invited both geniuses to collaborate on this endeavor. However, Madam Herta has yet to give a definitive response.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: We remain confident that Amphoreus, in due course, will establish itself as a beacon within the cosmic community.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: After several Amber Eras of relentless effort, the "Worlds Reborn Initiative" has recently successfully entered into its third phase, marked by the extensive restoration of cultural heritage from Ahatopia's "ancient Benzaitengoku."
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Once confined to a picturesque World in Canvas, Planarcadia, located on Ahatopia, has become reality for its imagenae inhabitants thanks to IPC assistance. Their unique artistic creations are now being shared throughout the universe via the Interastral Network.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Madam Pearl, secretary of the Strategic Investment Department, announced that the upcoming stage of the Worlds Reborn Initiative will center on "artistic innovation," driving robust growth in cultural sectors.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Meanwhile, preparations for the newest Phantasmoon Games are well underway. Established by the Aeon of Elation, this time-honored event continues to attract interest from all corners.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation wishes the ceremony every success, expressing the hope that happiness and celebration will spread throughout all of Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: A short while ago, New Eden-III, an important mining facility under the umbrella of the IPC, fell victim to a hacking attack.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Previously ravaged in the fight against the Legion, the planet underwent reconstruction, during which massive reserves of antimatter crystal ore were identified underground.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Following a thorough assessment, the IPC approved a development plan for the mine, believing that its high concentration of Imaginary Energy will provide a significant boost to the region's industrial recovery.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The head of the mining site reported receiving an anonymous warning prior to the attack. Currently, excavation has been halted due to a network outage.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: An investigation by the IPC's cybersecurity department has confirmed that Silver Wolf, a member of the Stellaron Hunters, was behind the recent cyberattack.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation strongly condemns such acts of public property destruction and threats to cosmic security, and has increased the bounty on Silver Wolf by one billion credits.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: We encourage all citizens of the cosmos to come forward with any information. This station will issue additional rewards to those who provide useful leads.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: And this is the end of our broadcast. Please tune in for our next episode. Thank you for listening.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Goodbye.

rows.text: Recently, traces of the Lord Ravager Celenova have appeared at the edges of the Sedounirama star cluster.

rows.text: As the vanguard of the Destruction, Celenova is notorious throughout the universe for bringing disaster to all living beings.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Faced with this threat, the six civilized worlds of the Sedounirama star cluster have formed an alliance and launched a counterattack on Celenova.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation stands firmly on the side of peace and justice. The Sedounirama star cluster has our full support. Let us all wish them success in this fight.

rows.text: A few days ago, an unusual incident occurred on Oceton, a hub planet famous for its Intellitron implants.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Overnight, the implants of all residents suffered deep corrosion, and the starport is now no longer functional. This has had a severe impact on transportation work.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation has promptly intervened, bringing the situation on Oceton under control and preventing it from worsening.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The IPC has a wealth of experience dealing with similar Intellitron crises. After peaceful negotiations, the Strategic Investment Department officially took over on Oceton and is dealing with the aftermath.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The infamous Memosnatcher "Mausolea" has turned herself in. This criminal is wanted for destroying many precious cultural relics throughout the universe, including the Tortani stone inscriptions, the Merlo Nebula scroll paintings, and the ruins of the Plodov spacetime dam.

rows.text: According to reports, during her most recent vandalism attempt, she saw a mysterious woman conversing with an Inquisition Spirit. This woman was wearing a candy-colored dress, but her face was not clearly visible.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Mausolea claims that this woman was the "Lord of Silence" Polka Kakamond and that her own life is now in danger. As a result, she has turned herself in and requested aid from the Genius Society.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Genius Society #83, Madam Herta, refused to extradite the Memosnatcher, but she showed considerable interest in the questions posed to the Lord of Silence by the Inquisition Spirit.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Sizzling Thunder is a celebrated band from Emerald-III. This planet's star system was completely destroyed by the expansion of its red giant star, but the band refused to leave their home. Through their final tour, they demonstrated their tenacious will to live.

rows.text: The Garden of Recollection has been preserving the "memories" of the band's last tour. On the advice of the IPC, in order to express their support for recovery across the universe, the Garden shared these memories with the many worlds participating in planetary revitalization projects.

rows.text: This performance recently came to a satisfying conclusion. The live audiences were deeply moved and said they would never be able to forget Sizzling Thunder.

rows.text: The Planet of Festivities "Penacony" has been hit by an abrupt Stellaron incursion, leading to the unforeseen interruption of the Charmony Festival.

rows.text: The incident has garnered widespread attention across various worlds. But thanks to the collaborative efforts of The Family, the IPC, and the Nameless, the Stellaron threat has been successfully handled.

rows.text: During this period, the Strategic Investment Department of the IPC held fruitful discussions with Family representatives. Both parties agreed to resume bilateral trade in order to collectively address the challenge posed by nefarious powers throughout the cosmos.

rows.text: Moving forward, the IPC plans to partner closely with Penacony in areas such as tourism, manufacturing, and cultural arts, with the aim of enhancing the luster of this celebrated Planet of Festivities.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The once-quiet Galaxy Rangers have made a notable reappearance in the Asdana system, marking the first significant mobilization of the group since the Crimson Vonwacq event of 2155 AE, indicating a momentous resurgence.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Galaxy Rangers' stay in Asdana was brief and conflict-free. Sources suggest that this activity might be connected to the Nihility's Self-Annihilator.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Local witnesses reported experiencing inexplicable dark emotions and seeing strange occurrences like black holes and fissures shortly before the Galaxy Rangers made their appearance.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation calls for prudence: Entities throughout the cosmos should exercise caution and self-control, ensuring personal grievances do not result in the harm of innocent civilians.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Reports indicate that in the last three Amber Eras, mental illnesses have emerged as a top concern across numerous planets.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation is delighted to announce our Technology Department has established a long-term partnership with Murong from the Doctors of Chaos, aimed at providing medical assistance to worlds engulfed in mental health crises.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation holds the conviction that the Nihility is not an insurmountable adversary.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: In the days ahead, the IPC will allocate more resources towards addressing mental health issues, with the hope that every individual and every world can face each day with a positive and healthy mindset.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Xianzhou Luofu is set to conduct a Wardance ceremony, welcoming attendees from numerous allied worlds to observe.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Wardance is a celebratory tradition within the Xianzhou Alliance. Throughout this celebration, a Xianzhou vessel pays tribute to the Cloud Knight victories achieved under the Aeon, The Hunt, through displays of combat and competitive events.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: According to reports, this is the Xianzhou Alliance's first outreach to the cosmic populace since the Antimatter Legion's attack. The progress of their recovery is something we'll watch with interest.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Stay with Interastral Peace Broadcast for full live coverage of the Wardance's thrilling competitions. We encourage viewers to tune in and enjoy the action.

rows.text: After a prolonged silence, it has been verified that the industrial world Baranza Forge has been invaded by the Lord Ravager Irontomb, plunging it into a state of complete paralysis.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Sources indicate that the Lord Ravager Irontomb frequently targets technologically advanced worlds, employing ruthless methods to obliterate highly developed civilizations.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Baranza Forge plays a vital role in the manufacturing of Synesthesia Beacons. The implications of this assault will undoubtedly influence the IPC's frontier pioneering efforts.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The IPC strongly condemns the barbaric atrocities committed by the Antimatter Legion, and calls upon civilizations across the universe to unite and resist the invasion of the Destruction.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Just days ago, the first rescue team arrived on Baranza Forge, and will work alongside the Garden of Recollection to salvage valuable technology achievements, and assist survivors in rebuilding their lives.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Broadcast remains committed to following the Baranza event closely. We'd like to extend our condolences to the victims and hope that peace will prevail.

rows.text: And this is the end of our broadcast. Please tune in for our next episode. Thank you for listening.

rows.text: Renowned songstress, Robin, has received an invitation to perform at Penacony's Charmony Festival.

rows.text: The Garden of Recollection has gathered memoria fragments from the lost world of Moonshield — the precious memories of this world will not be forgotten.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Let's take a closer look at the details.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Regarding the IPC and the Xianzhou Alliance: The Xianzhou Luofu has opted to renew the trade agreement.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The agreement will help to open up markets and promote cooperation between the two sides in agriculture, industry, medicine, and culture, laying a solid foundation for a free, open, and prosperous business environment.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: At the signing of the agreement, friendly talks were held between Madam Yukong, Sky-Faring Helm Master of the Luofu, and a representative of the IPC's Marketing Development Department. The two sides reached a consensus on various issues, including the impact of interstellar security on the free market.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The IPC also expressed their heartfelt concern for the Luofu regarding the recent invasion by the Antimatter Legion and sent their condolences to the victims.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The IPC strongly condemns the barbaric atrocities committed by the Antimatter Legion and conveys the Amber Lord's wish for Preservation to all worlds ravaged by that wretched force.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Emperor Rubert I left many horrific relics across the universe, and one of them, the Mechanical Emperor Tomb, has captivated the interests of countless people since its discovery.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The excavation of the tomb is headed by the head of the Armed Archaeologists of the Intelligentsia Guild, Allen Drake One-Armed Jones, with assistance from Genius Society member, Screwllum. It is hoped that the excavation of this metallic relic, which holds a Category Omega ranking on the Potential Disaster Index, will finally shed a light on its mysterious nature.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: According to records of the Emperor's deeds left behind by the Inorganic Legion, the original purpose of the site was to "house the inventions inspired by the imagination of Rubert I."
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: A spokesperson for the Intelligentsia Guild said, "We have no way of knowing what amazing discoveries Jones will uncover, but we are hopeful that his findings will further our understanding of the Emperor and help save the universe from the horrors that he will bring with him when he returns."
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Broadcast will be covering this story throughout the excavation.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Penacony, the Planet of Festivities, announced that it will invite renowned singer, Robin, to perform at the Charmony Festival.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Once every Amber-Era, countless followers of the Harmony will attend this long-held tradition of the Planet of Festivities, and together pray for a brighter and better future for the universe.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Robin is a superstar whose voice is known throughout the cosmos. She has been the recipient of many top awards.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: It is believed that during the celebrations, Robin will sing a hymn for the Aeon of the Harmony in the name of The Family.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The IPC will broadcast the entire event, sending the sounds of music and good wishes to worlds far and wide.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: As we all know, the Garden of Recollection has always been committed to the restoration of lost civilizations, igniting the spark of revival across the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: According to reliable sources, thanks to the efforts of the Memokeepers, all memoria fragments of the deadworld of Moonshield have been salvaged.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Moonshield was destroyed during an invasion by the Antimatter Legion, but with the combined efforts of the IPC and the Garden of Remembrance, the collection of information about the fallen world was recently declared a success. The Memokeepers plan for it to be reborn in the pristine land of the Remembrance.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Destruction can destroy any material thing, but it can never take away our hope. The IPC will provide whatever support and protection within its means for the long-term development of all civilizations across the universe — including those that have perished.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: And this is the end of our broadcast. Please tune in for our next episode. Thank you for listening.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Thank you.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Welcome to the Interastral Peace Broadcast. Good evening everyone.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Good evening.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Welcome to a new episode of Interastral Peace Broadcast. We are here to bring you the latest news from across the galaxy.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Signal transmissions from Jarilo-VI have been detected. This could mean that there are still survivors on the icy planet.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Omen Vanguards have warned the Sigmar-III galaxy about the potential spread of malignant silicon-eating bacteria.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Armed Archaeologists of the Intelligentsia Guild have discovered a miniature galaxy on Hellem. Further investigation is being conducted.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: It has been confirmed that The Cremators are responsible for the Holstein Aphasia. Galaxy Rangers have announced that they are working on retrieving stolen memories and that the investigation is ongoing.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Let's take a closer look at the details.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: A sales rep from the Jarilo branch of Interastral Peace Appliances told us that signal transmissions have been detected from Jarilo-VI, a planet that has been sealed under heavy snow for over 700 years.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The IPC responded promptly and performed an analysis on the signals.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The message that the signals contain states that the natives of the planet have survived the catastrophe that happened many Amber Eras ago and recently received help from a group known as the Nameless, which allowed them to put an end to the Eternal Freeze.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The IPC has sent out investigators to assess the situation on Jarilo-VI. Let us hope that the survivors can return to the Path of Preservation as soon as possible!
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Omen Vanguards recently reached out to the IPC and warned about the spread of a certain strain of bacteria.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Members from the Vanguards have asked the IPC to alert the residents that there are signs of an outbreak of a malignant silicon-eating bacteria in Sigmar-III. The bacteria had previously been seen proliferating in Mollis-II.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Experts from the Intelligentsia Guild suggest that this type of bacteria can peel off the silicon atoms stored in the vast majority of silicates and silicone compounds via violent biochemical reactions. It will then use these silicon atoms to duplicate itself.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: In this process, the bacteria will generate a membrane that is highly corrosive. When not handled properly, this type of bacteria can pose a serious hazard to health and safety.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The IPC calls upon the leaders of mechanical life forms in Sigmar-III to take action to contain the bacteria and safeguard public health.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The spokesperson of the Armed Archaeologists under the Intelligentsia Guild stated in a recent press conference that a squad dispatched to Hellem has discovered a miniature galaxy in a cave located near the planet's southern tropical latitudes.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The squad was conducting demolition missions on certain mountain ranges when they discovered a curious facility in the shape of a container. After investigation, the squad was convinced that there was a Sub-space field within the facility and confirmed its function.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The squad leader told the IPC that the sub-space field they had discovered was in fact a miniature artificially made galaxy and that they were fairly certain that it was still populated.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: As of now, the squad has been carrying out further work in an attempt to contact the galaxy's residents. We will bring you more updates on this developing story as they become available.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: A member of the Galaxy Rangers who wishes to remain anonymous claims that The Cremators are behind the Holstein Aphasia that occurred in early 2157 AE.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Research from reliable sources suggest that certain criminal groups snatched all the memories relating to "language" from the residents of Holstein via unconventional means.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The residents of Holstein have since lost the ability to produce speech. To this day, the Holstein galaxy remains silent.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: There is some good news, though — with the help of the IPC, the residents of Holstein have learned to communicate through written language.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: And this is the end of our broadcast. Please tune in for our next episode. Thank you for listening.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Goodbye.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Welcome to the Interastral Peace Broadcast. Good evening everyone.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Good evening.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: As Qlipoth the Preservation's giant hammer slowly descends, its strike echoes among the stars with a deafening clamor.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Intelligentsia Guild's Astral Ecology School has declared the official end of 2157 AE and the start of 2158 AE.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: In this new Era, the Interastral Peace Corporation will continue to wholeheartedly support the peaceful co-existence and commercial prosperity of all residents in the galaxy.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The IPC will remain true to its sole creed upon which it was founded — To dedicate everything to the Amber Lord.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Let's take a moment to look back at some of the biggest happenings in 2157 AE.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The mysterious phenomenon known as Stellaron corrosion continues to propagate. Stellarons have blocked travel between civilizations since 2147 AE, and they shattered the union of the worlds that were once united under the Path of the Amber Lord.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: For the entirety of the past ten Amber Eras, the Interastral Peace Corporation has never given up on our hope of reconnecting the worlds.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: With the Intelligentsia Guild's ardent support, we have begun developing technologies to bypass Stellaron Corrosion. Experiments conducted across 113 galaxies have shown promising results.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The galaxy is vast, yet we are not alone. The Astral Express, once piloted by the fallen Aeon Akivili the Trailblaze, has embarked on its journey once again.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: These young Nameless claim to have inherited the will of Akivili and will re-establish the access routes between the stars, recreating the First Prosperity from 990 Amber Eras ago.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: On behalf of the Interastral Peace Corporation, we wish the best of luck to the Trailblazers of the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: While the residents of the galaxy are plagued by the Stellarons, a new evil organization called the Stellaron Hunters has been stirring up trouble.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: As we previously discussed on our program, the Stellaron Hunters illegally gained access to Planet Screwllum, which is under the purview of the Genius Society, and clashed with the head of the planet, Screwllum.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Our latest reports suggest that the criminal group has recently been spotted on the Xianzhou Luofu. The IPC's Special Commissioner to the Alliance has contacted General Jing Yuan of the Luofu to verify this information. We have yet to receive a response.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Stellaron Hunters have committed many significant crimes. Any one of their members has the power to destroy a planet, and it remains uncertain which Aeon the group is loyal to. They are classified as extremely dangerous terrorists.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: If you encounter anyone suspected of being a Stellaron Hunter, please contact the IPC immediately and do not act on your own. Anyone who provides useful information will be substantially rewarded.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Meanwhile, many factions have received an invitation to Penacony, the Planet of Festivities. This is the first time that The Family in Penacony has openly sent formal invitations to all galactic factions.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation is among the factions invited. The head of the Strategic Investment Department, Diamond, has stated that we will carefully examine the purpose behind this gesture, and respond to it in a positive and friendly manner.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: We look forward to having all galactic factions join together to protect our homelands and defend against the invasion of evil forces.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: The Lord Ravager, Zephyro, was spotted at the Tia'nua galaxy. According to the Mourning Actors, that galaxy has been completely destroyed.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: The Antimatter Legion is ravaging through the galaxy and has caused countless calamities. The IPC would like to remind everyone to remember the significance of the Preservation.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: Any planet with a telepathy beacon can obtain from the IPC free copies of the Interastral Peace Guide written by the Architects.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: At the beginning of 2158 AE, the Interastral Peace Corporation would like to proudly announce that the famous scientist, Madam Herta of the Genius Society, has officially committed to a long-term alliance and cooperative relationship with the IPC.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Madam Herta is the third genius of the Erudition to partner with the IPC, after Member #22 Aiden and Member #56 Elias Salas. The Corporation stands united with Madam Herta to protect the Amber Lord's universe.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: And this is the end of our broadcast. Please tune in for our next episode. Thank you for listening.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Goodbye.
rows.speaker: Male Voice

rows.text: ...S—Sounds like you had a nightmare! We just arrived in Asdana and already... You should be careful, it seems your tolerance to memoria isn't the strongest.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Aside from that, I have to say The Family has been really accommodating...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I am Misha, a bell boy, working here on Penacony. Pleased to be at your service. If you need help with your baggage...
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Ahem, hi, hello~ Attention all passengers.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The Express is about to make the jump — the Express is about to make the jump — Please be seated and hold on!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: [Trailblazer], what's wrong? Wh—Why are you crying all of a sudden?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Don't fret, dreams are often the reverse of reality. While you were sleeping, the Express arrived at Penacony...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: ...Can you imagine? Yesterday's grim frontier prison is today's lavish hotel. I wish I could wander Penacony's streets today, but I'm pretty train-tied at the moment. You'll have to be my eyes and ears while we're here.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: ...Gear up and make sure you've got everything! And before you step out, swing by the back and grab March, she's waiting for you there.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: We're here at last! The Family sure doesn't play around with their entry protocols. Our bags probably know what it feels like to be a celebrity now, with all that attention!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wouldn't have put it past them to try and nab that Stellaron from inside you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, the hassle was worth it — just look at this grand hotel lobby! And those endless rows, they're all rooms, right? Just think of the number of guests staying here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Where are our rooms? Come on, Mr. Yang and the rest must be at the front desk. Let's hurry up and meet them there!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Welcome to the Reverie! May you experience an unforgettable holiday! If you need help checking in, please head straight to the concierge.
[Trailblazer], over here, something's not right...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Should you need assistance with moving your luggage to your room, feel free to contact me. Please go ahead, don't keep your friend waiting.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Now I Am Become Trailblaze, the Perambulator of Walls.
I feel a bit faint...
Who are you?
What is this place?
Where are we going?
Perhaps we have.
Probably not.
I don't know.
What do you mean?
What's going on...
I cannot bear such a fear.
If it means losing them, I would.
If it means that I will disappear, I would.
I feel no fear.
I don't know.
I would, no matter the cost.
If I didn't have to pay any price, I would.
That depends on the price I'd have to pay.
I would never want to live in a dream.
I don't know.
I would abandon it — the price is too dear.
I would abandon it — I have already tasted the beauty of dreams.
I would abandon it — Trailblazing was never my intent.
I would blaze a trail without hesitation.
I don't know.
I seem to remember you from somewhere...
No, this is the first time we've met.
Will we meet again?
You haven't told me how to leave this place...
Not another one...
...Come with me.
These questions... have no meaning. But, I will answer you as best as I can: This is the border between reality and the Memory Zone, a... dreamscape.
Right this moment, you and I have coincidentally shared the same dreamscape, and appeared in each other's minds. This is the Land of Dreams's inaugural welcome for us.
Worry not, for very quickly, you will awaken from this dream, forget everything that has transpired, with naught but a faint lingering of loss.
Pay no mind, for this forgetfulness happens with each new dawn. It is an occurrence that we have become accustomed to for so long.
...So, come with me. I'll take you home.
Galaxy Ranger, Acheron... This is what they call me. You can call me whatever you want.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Left, to the end of the corridor. I will wait there for you.
I'm not there. Turn back.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Open this door... Take a look at the mesmerizing dreamscape, while you can still remember.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: (This is, no way...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: This way.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: After you.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: (Am I supposed to walk up the wall...?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (How is this even possible!?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Why not?)
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: (She can hear the thoughts in my head?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Why not?)
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: These voices... They are just shadows of the dreamscape. Pay no heed to them.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Ah, the charming audacity! To think that you, of all people, might emerge victorious, dear gambler.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Three chips are enough. All or nothing.
The Charmony Festival's stage belongs only to you, little sister.
But if I can't sing... what meaning does a stage have?
Memokeeper... Do you think you can just leave?
I'm sorry. The dance partner of my choice... I've already chosen.
How do you intend to pull them off the stage?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: All we have to do is present the truth, and they will naturally reciprocate.
Welcome to the Reverie! May you experience an unforgettable holiday! If you need help checking in, please head straight to the concierge...
We're almost there. Can you still walk?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You're funny. If you can crack jokes, you're probably fine.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Don't panic, this is normal.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Don't stop, don't turn back, don't look down. Or up, for that matter.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Welcome to the Reverie! May you experience an unforgettable holiday! If you need help checking in, please head straight to the concierge...
Leave this realm, and rise as you would on any other day. Forget this fortuitous encounter, and return whence you came.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But before you do, I would make a request of you.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You may think it somewhat strange, perhaps even rude, but I wish to know...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Have we met somewhere before?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: {M#You evoke memories of an old friend. In the haze of my recollections, he crossed blades with me, much like this surreal dreamscape where we stood close, yet forever out of reach.}{F#You evoke memories of an old friend. In the haze of my recollections, she stood shoulder to shoulder with me, much like this surreal dreamscape where we stood close, yet forever out of reach.}
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: May I ask you a few more questions? I... tend to forget things — which is why, rather than memories, I'm accustomed to using my emotions to capture what I normally wouldn't otherwise. The answer is inconsequential. Your spontaneous reaction is what matters.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: For instance, when you awaken in your room, your lips speak several names. Are they your companions? Family? Enemies? You seem to have forged unbreakable bonds with many people and many incidents...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Might I ask if you fear losing these bonds?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Mm... Then, if there was a vast dreamscape, so lifelike it's indistinguishable from reality. There, no one faces life's separations or deaths. Everyone attains their deserved happiness and lives joyfully ever after.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would ask: Would you wish to stay?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Now... imagine if this splendid dream were fated to fall apart: Friends, family, strangers, followed by the gentle breeze, soaring birds, the stars... and ultimately, yourself.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Everyone, and every face they remember, the joy and the heartaches, the vows sealed and those left hanging... all will inevitably march towards a predetermined ending. If you had grasped the journey's finale right from its inception...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would ask: Would you still embark on this journey?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I know this is hard, you don't have to be hard-pressed to make a decision. As I have said... the answer is inconsequential.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Hearing, touch, thought — through these, you gain emotions — cherish them. With emotions, we make choices. And so we return to the original question...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would ask... Do you still remember me?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...I understand.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: How interesting. For a split second, it felt like countless versions of you, alike yet distinct, gave entirely different responses.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That was my final question, thank you. We all have our paths to walk, so we shall bid our farewells.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The golden dream is getting restless. In the coming long night, I'm afraid you will face many tribulations and witness many tragedies. And finally... your sight will only see black and white.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But please believe me that in that monochrome world, there will be a glimpse of fleeting red, and when you make a choice, it will reappear before you once more...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...We're here.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I'm already a little winded.
I hope we don't run into any more trouble.
Are all The Family names so strange?

This is my room.
Why haven't you left?
(I have a strange feeling about this...)
I was about to ask too...

Probably not.

Is there something else?

How do you know?
Do you still remember me?

The fall didn't hurt at all!
I think I'm hallucinating...

This is deep...
Does that mean I can levitate in the air?
Something wrong?
What's going on?
And yes, I'm Mr. Dan Heng, reporting for duty.

Wait a minute, I'm sorry, but are you... the...?

rows.text: The singer, Epsilon's superstar... If I Can Stop One Heart From Breaking. That's your song, isn't it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I never thought a cutie like yourself would be a fan of mine.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Ahh, it really is Robin! To run into her in person here...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It is an honor to meet everyone.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Are you also a member of The Family on Penacony like him?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Truth be told, I am a guest like everyone. Penacony is my hometown, but I left when I was older. I was graciously invited this time to return and sing a song at the Charmony Festival.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: The person you speak of is Sunday, my senior, and one of the local leaders of Penacony. He is also the organizer of this era's Charmony Festival. He heard you all ran into some difficulties, and sent me here to provide aid.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Alas, I arrived a little later than usual. I sincerely apologize for any unpleasantness during your stay.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Please be at ease, I have instructed Miss Alley to resolve the system error as soon as possible. I have also upgraded your rooms as token compensation. Please wait a moment for the hotel to arrange for suitable accommodation.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine has an appointment with the Oak Family, and has checked in prior. On his behalf, I extend his apologies to everyone of the Astral Express, and wish for an amicable partnership moving forward.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Thank you for stepping in to resolve this matter, but are you sure about the rooms? I wouldn't want your other guests to feel we were being given preferential treatment...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Please rest assured that The Family will personally undertake communications to handle this. It is only right that we — as the actual administrators — relieve you of any problems during your visit in Penacony.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I apologize for taking up everyone's precious time, and we shan't keep you any longer. If you need anything else while in Penacony, The Family stands ready to serve.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: May your dreams be beautiful and pleasant.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: *sigh* It's just one surprise after another. But since that mister... which day was he? Sunday. Since Mr. Sunday has vouched for us, I guess we can finally check in normally?

rows.text: How does the saying go? "Trouble comes in pairs"...

rows.text: Okay, there's no queue in the lobby now. Let's go find Miss Alley...

rows.text: ...Your room?

rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Don't misunderstand, that was a mere reminder. This place runs deep, with plenty of unsavory characters. Don't forget to stay on your toes. Like... keeping your door closed.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'll make my exit now, [Trailblazer]! Have a pleasant stay.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Why haven't you left?
