rows.text: ...Have I come to the wrong room? This can't be. Before I said anything, I even made sure that I had the right room number...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Do I have the wrong wing... or even the wrong block? I'm sorry, this hotel is huge, and the hallways all look the same. It's easy to get lost in here...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I'm trying to find my own room too, and I heard a commotion here... so I came to take a look. Luckily your door was open, or it could've gotten dangerous. That man looked like he was up to no good.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I later saw you walking into the same room, so I began to connect the dots. The situation got a bit tense... I hope you don't mind that I pulled this stunt.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Anyway, as long as you're all right. I should return to my room too.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But before I go, can I ask you a question? You may think it somewhat strange, perhaps even rude, but I wish to know...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Have we met somewhere before?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: *smiles* You forget, that man mentioned it before he left. My memory's not very good, but it's not so bad that I can't remember details from just minutes ago.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Galaxy Ranger, Acheron... This is what they call me. You can call me whatever you want. We will likely meet again.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Lastly, a gentle reminder... There are people who possess unwavering resolution and faith, even unto death, and they do not wield such conviction for good. And on that man's face, I see such a similar expression.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: One who wears a blade must use it to cut eventually. And when a gambler has nothing to lose on the table, he will surely go for broke and bet it all on a final hand... That is all I can say.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I thought you should know all this before making a choice. Goodbye.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: (Acheron left... Strange... I can't shake off this odd feeling I have...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Forget it. It's taken a while, but at least I can finally enter the dream... Hmm?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Mmm...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Sorry, can you point me in the direction of the lobby? All these hallways really look the same to me...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You show Acheron the way, she thanks you again and again.
I jest. Take it easy, this is indeed your room. I was just passing by...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I was just teasing, please forgive me. This is indeed your room. I saw that man snooping about while I was in the hallway, it didn't seem like he was searching for his own room, so it made me wary...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Is that so? I haven't been able to shake off this familiar feeling since just now... Maybe this is what they call déjà vu, hehe. Or it could purely be serendipity.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: [Trailblazer], this is your name, isn't it? Pleased to meet you.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This may sound embarrassing, because I would sometimes forget stuff I really shouldn't have from past experiences... It's just a habit of mine, don't mind me.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Yes, it was a dream. I had a dream on my way here, and I think you were in it... A blink of a thought in my head...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Esteemed guests of the Astral Express, your check-in procedure is complete. Please forgive us for any previous inconvenience caused.
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: This is your Dreamscape Pass: It serves as your hotel room key, as well as a directory of all the amenities and information you require at The Reverie. It even provides smart assistance.
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: At the same time, it is also Penacony's special one-of-a-kind souvenir that belongs only to you!
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: You can use the Dreamscape Pass's provided clock-in feature to record every moment of your wonderful dream, save your favorite happy bits, and create a Dreamscape Scrapbook that is uniquely yours.
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: Regarding the method of usage, the Dreamscape Pass will guide you through the process.
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: I wish you all pleasant dreams in Penacony. You may take the elevator over there to reach your guest rooms.
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: Alright! Let's move out!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer]! Are you alright?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Hehe, well you are in the Dreamscape, after all.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Hehe, that's a normal reaction for first-time visitors to the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Haha, there's nothing to worry about — you've arrived at the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Seems like our guest here hasn't gotten used to the transition. Fret not, feeling a sense of weightlessness is normal for new visitors.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Robin, please guide our friend in getting more comfortable with the new environment.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Leave it to me.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Robin gives a slight nod to her brother, then locks her emerald gaze with yours. She smiles, and you see ripples shimmering in the depths of her lake-green eyes, followed by a mighty vortex emerging from the depths of the pool.

Your vision dims as your body dissolves, becoming one with the fluidity of the time-space. You resonate with and become attuned to the serene fusion of frequencies. Your heart drums, leading this symphony.
Don't worry, just relax. You'll be feeling like your normal self in no time.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: The choir starts. "Inhale." They sing. "Now Exhale." They chant. Instinct compels, and the stagnant fluid in your chest begins to flow again.

A gentle warmth emanates from within, saturating every inch of your being. Your melodies slow down, fade away, like a lullaby. A seven-colored illusion delicately caresses the top of your head and closes your eyes, its movements tender and compassionate. You feel contentment and drift into a deep slumber.
You open your eyes and feel a vitality like no other. The difficulty you were experiencing a moment earlier feels like a distant memory.
You should be feeling fully in control now. [Trailblazer], welcome to Penacony.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I've merely changed your state of mind for you to feel more at ease.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I've merely changed your state of mind for you to feel more at ease.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: It was a song with a harmonic tune.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Relax. She just did some tuning on you with the resonance of the Harmony to allow you to control your limbs freely in the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Essentially, the dream of Penacony is a world formed by memoria. Only by fully understanding its nature can you move freely within it.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It's like learning to swim — it's easy to sink at first when you aren't accustomed to the water, but once you get the hang of it you can float and swim on the surface effortlessly.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Thanks for the compliment. In fact, we don't really have an in-depth understanding of the memoria.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Indeed. But still, we don't really have an in-depth understanding of the memoria.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Theoretically, you can, but it would be very difficult to pull off. After all, we don't really have an in-depth understanding of the memoria yet.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Unless you're one of the Memokeepers of the Garden of Recollection, it can be difficult at first to manipulate the memoria as you wish. But once you've been tuned by the Harmony, you can use the same laws of physics from the real world to understand how the dream world works.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Oops... I've fallen into my professional habits again. I just can't seem to shake off this urge to be a know-it-all.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Don't mind him — he's always like that. Please enjoy the beautiful dreamscape The Family has built for everyone. We shall take our leave. Have a blast!
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Welcome to the Reverie! May you have an unforgettable holiday! Should you need assistance with moving your luggage to your room, feel free to contact me.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: I hear this hotel is pretty unique.
So Penacony is...
I hear The Family held a grand event.
I have nothing else to ask.

Yeah, it is! The Reverie does not only provide accommodation for its guests, it is also connected to both Penacony's reality and dreamscape. Guests from all over the cosmos come here to immerse themselves in a marvelous, dreamy journey.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Aren't dreams fake?
Won't I get tired out from all that dreaming?
How is it working here?
I see, got it.
A good question! Maybe not all dreams are false... Well, at least the ones in Penacony aren't. Or perhaps should I say they are... another reality.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: The hotel's Dreampool provides a comfortable dream experience, so don't you worry about that!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Er... Are you asking me? Hmm... It's not too bad. Many guests come and go, and I get to hear all about their adventures.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: You'll know what I mean when you enter a dream. Penacony will not disappoint!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Yes! This hotel is Penacony in real life. And the Penacony in the dream... is a place where miracles are born. A land of lavish joy, a grand banquet where the curtains never fall!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Mm... It's hard to describe its magnificence in words. In any case, you will surely be awed!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: You are well-informed indeed! It is an opportunity provided by The Family, and a tradition on the Planet of Festivities.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Everyone gathers in the hall, reveling in merriment, pursuing opportunities, staking all they have on one desperate gamble, and finally, their dreams become reality!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: May you have a pleasant stay in Penacony!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: I'm sorry, but your name really isn't in the system...
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: But in the information I received from the Astral Express, it states that we already reserved rooms. Please check again for me.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yes ma'am, please give me a moment...
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: The Astral Express, four platinum guest rooms... whose names include Mr. Welt Yang, Miss Himeko, Miss March 7th, and...
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: ...Mr. Dan Heng. These are the only four names on the reservation list.
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: Yes, your name isn't on the hotel's reservation list...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: We've run into some trouble. Your name isn't on the hotel's reservation list...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Dan Heng...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...I understand. No wonder [Trailblazer]'s name here is missing. When we responded to The Family's invitation, {F#she}{M#he} hadn't even arrived on the Express.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Something came up in Dan Heng's schedule, and he couldn't make it. I have an idea — could you reassign his room? It's still the same number of people.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: {M#He's}{F#She's} a new passenger aboard our Astral Express. We can vouch for {M#his}{F#her} status.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I— even if that is so, I'm afraid...
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: (Show Jade Abacus of Allying Oath...)
No, I'm not doubting your status, it's just...
rows.speaker: Alley

rows.text: Hello, friend. How have you been? I sincerely hope you don't mind.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I do mind.
It's fine, I don't mind it.
My apologies for any perceived slight. To show my sincerity, I offer you 10,000 credits as a gesture of goodwill.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: That's better.
You have no idea what friends are.
What're friends without friction! Now we're truly acquainted.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Such integrity, I like it! I must have you as a friend — here, 20,000 credits!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: My apologies for any perceived slight. To show my sincerity, I offer you 10,000 credits as a gesture of goodwill.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Then I'll gladly accept it.
Thank you, but we can spare the gifts.
That's the spirit! Nothing should come between friends. Tell me whatever you need, it's on my tab.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: How upright, I like you! I must have you as a friend — here, 20,000 credits!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Please excuse me, I have some matters to attend to, so I must depart, but I'm sure we'll meet again soon.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: What's wrong? Not turning in? Can't find your room, or do you have something on your mind?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: About the Watchmaker...
About that IPC representative...
About the dream journey...
That's enough chit-chat for now.

One can't discuss the Planet of Festivities without mentioning the Watchmaker — Penacony's household name and figure. Fortune, fame, status... He built everyone's futures with his bare hands, and became the symbol of dreams.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But the veracity of these stories... remains untraceable. Many have their own opinions on the Watchmaker's origin and past, and there are even some who suspect he is a conceptual construct of The Family.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: For now, I do not think this invite is linked to the Watchmaker. His legacy... It sounds more like a marketing hook to drum up more traffic, if nothing else.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: An IPC ambassador who knows more than he lets on, a silver-tongued businessman, a flamboyant and debonair aristocrat... He could be all of them. My instincts tell me he's much more than meets the eye.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Before the dust settles, we should maintain amicable relations with all camps, while keeping our guards up.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The dream Penacony is divided into twelve individual dreamscapes. I've heard that the destinations vary for different people when they first enter the dream.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As for me... I look forward to the Moment of Scorchsand — its wild winds, taverns, and {RUBY_B#SoulGlad™ Festivity Auditions • Scorchsand Venue}festive choices{RUBY_E#} have more of a Nameless Trailblaze vibe. The Moment of Morning Dew is also a decent choice — I can use that chance to visit The Family.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You must be exhausted from everything that's happened so far. Even if you're Trailblazing, you mustn't forget to relax. Goodnight, and sweet dreams.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The decor in here's a little... loud for my tastes. So this is how astral high society does things, huh...?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: About the Watchmaker...
About The Family...
About the dream journey...
That's enough chit-chat for now.

They say he's a historically important figure in Penacony, and tales of his life have been handed down over generations. Such tales encourage believers to come to the Planet of Festivities to pursue their dreams. He's an interesting fellow, that's for sure, and his legacy still has the power to draw people in.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But how and why he's involved with that invite, and why his name popped up in the encrypted message allegedly sent by a Nameless... I've got no leads for now.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The Family believes in the Harmony, and their altruism is well-known across the stars — a trait that is intimately tied to Penacony's stability and prosperity.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But some factions have always been wary of The Family — suspecting that their benevolence and eloquence belie an ulterior motive... So far, it seems to me that The Family treats their guests with courtesy, so I don't think we need to worry about that for now.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The dream Penacony is divided into twelve moments. Personally, I'm interested in the Moment of Sol — it's a visual dreamscape steeped in Penacony's history and civilization.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Penacony's Grand Museum, the Primal Waking Library, the Paperfold academy... The pasts that we chase may be stored in these places.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Past the guest room's Dreampool is the real Penacony. Let's get ready to move out. Pleasant dreams.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You approach the Dreampool and hear the sweet voice of a female singer coming from all around the room, fragrance permeating the air. Together, these two elements envelop you in their embrace. The scent is sweet, profound, and luxurious — reminiscent of ripened fruits and a distant ocean painted by the hues of a setting sun.
Perhaps, it's time to enter the dream.
Lie down in the Dreampool.
Not yet.

You curl your body, lying down in the center of the Dream Pool. The icy liquid rises above your waist. The gentle female voice continues to whisper in your ear, accompanied by the tolling of evening bells. The wild wind rustles through the barren plains, while nightingales, seagulls, swans, and ravens add their symphony to the choir...
Pendulum swings. You wonder what dream you'll delve into and slowly drift into drowsiness...
Welcome to Penacony, honored guest...
Astral Express guests, please come this way and rest your feet.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Wait, what!? You're...!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, what's the big gathering at the concierge about? We've just arrived and there's already drama?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: A dream world... I heard that Penacony transformed the dreamscape into a majestic metropolis...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What exactly would that look like? I can't wait!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Our rooms are down this way.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This is a long hallway... Is it just me, or is this hotel too big for its own good?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Head back to your rooms, get some rest, and prepare to enter the dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: (It's time to head back to my room... Before entering the dream, I should probably talk to the rest.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Seems like it's over. Time to work the Dreampool according to the Dreamscape Pass' instructions...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Odd... Why's my room door open?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Hmm? He's...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Woah! What a big bathtub...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Very soon, all your dreams will leap forth before you...
Please step into the Dreampool and let go of the sorrows and worries of life...
Close your eyes, and let happy memories surge forth...
See you... in the next life...
Revel in... sweet dreams...
Very soon, the boundary between reality and dream will cease to exist...
The Moment of Dusk, obviously! How can you not visit the shopping paradise when you're at the resort of all resorts! I'm all ready to fill my bags to the brim!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You know, it's weird. Welt noticed it too, about how Miss Robin's voice sounded somewhat weary... I can't quite put my finger on it, but it was different than usual?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Here I was, thinking of some good ol' relaxation, but nope! This "event" is a wild ride! The various factions deciphering the riddle, a power struggle of past legacies — feels like we're in a live-action detective saga!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry, Welt and Himeko will have our backs if things go wrong. Let's just make the most of it all while we're here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just kidding, how could that be possible?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's because you were zonked out the whole ride. No one had the chance to tell you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Penacony's situation is getting complicated. Let's tread lightly.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Who sent the invite, what is the purpose of gathering all the factions into Penacony, and why does The Family choose to remain silent about their knowledge of this... There are too many unanswered questions. We must use the utmost caution before we go deeper.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's right, pal!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Calm down, I'm just here to soak in the festive vibe. This may be your room now, but half a system hour ago, it was still mine.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Of course. What, you thought The Family acted simply out of their own good will?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: No no, I only let you have my room.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'm not sure I like that tone...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Penacony's a true-blue land of dreams. How many across the stars would spend half their lives, just to acquire an admission ticket into The Reverie?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Cutting to the chase, I like that.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Wrong. You're the one I seek.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Simply put, my friend, I need your help. You may or may not know this, but Penacony's far murkier than it seems. The Family's eyes are everywhere, but you get the drift.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I know now.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Your acting's good, I like that.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Warning me! Hahaha, you're too funny.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You don't have to answer me now. Sit on it for a while. When the time is right, I will look for you again.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Mm, very well.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I already said there's no rush to give me an answer. Because no matter what happens... the outcome will remain the same.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I already said there's no rush to give me an answer. Because no matter what happens... the outcome will remain the same.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh yes, before I go, let's play another game — a simple game, to get to know each other better. You just have to guess which hand the chip is hiding in. It'll help you get a better grasp on my personality, and the way I do things...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: We're finally here. Let's all head to our rooms first and put down our bags.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Welt, how about a drink first? Penacony's SoulGlad is very famous.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Go on. We may be thinking of the same thing.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Do you remember the invite that the Express received?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "The Family's esteemed guests are cordially invited to Penacony to participate in our grand celebration." That's why we're here in the first place.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You recall correctly, but there was more to this invite.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "...Witness the impossible in the realm of dreams, find the Legacy of the Watchmaker, Father of Penacony, and thus the answer to the question: Why does life slumber."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I don't remember that part of the invite... You mean, there was a hidden message?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This is the part that intrigues me — the invite sent by The Family was nothing more than a music box that, when wound, would play an accompanying tune.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But the box that was sent to us was slightly unusual... The music it played had off-key notes in the background.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I recorded these dissonant notes, and they were a perfect match with the gravity wave frequency when the Express made its warp jump. Also, the Express engine's spatial curvature was its encryption key.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...A distress call method regularly used by the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I can't be certain. It may be a Masked Fool's trap. From the execution itself, the Riddlers or Inquisition Spirits could have done this themselves.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: When did you discover this?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: When we were handling that Luofu Stellaron matter. I told Pom-Pom about it first thing.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's no wonder that IPC ambassador also mentioned this "Watchmaker." The invite he received must also have contained a hidden message, and it seems like he decoded it.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...There's something else on my mind. When the invite was brought up, that Family leader mentioned being one of the "actual administrators" of Penacony, and that it was their duty to "relieve" us of any problems.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: In hindsight, there was more to that statement. He also had Miss Robin with him... I'm no singer, but her voice sounded a little strange... Would a singer really take to the stage if their voice wasn't in top shape?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Are you saying... you suspect that The Family did not send the invite, and... is hiding something from us?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's possible. The fact that The Family sent out invites to the other factions is already unusual. And your discovery confirms that there could be a third party involved... I take back what I said: This "event" is becoming more interesting with each passing second.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Why didn't you tell the others?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: We shouldn't interfere if this is just an internal affair of Penacony or The Family.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But you said so yourself: This could concern the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Well, I did, which is why...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...before we set off, I told March 7th and Dan Heng about this.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So I was the only one kept in the dark then.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Right now, let's just focus on the conductor's request: We'll collect intel while enjoying this "wonderful vacation." Penacony is, after all, a famed resort of the cosmos. Not many get a chance to even visit in their lifetime.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: How fortuitous, we meet again.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: A lucky block number, a lucky floor, a lucky room number. You have no idea how much I went through to book this precious space... And now I've given it to you. Treasure it well, friend.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Think about the type of people who can even afford to stay here. If it wasn't for my brilliant plan, you think The Family would offend those bigwigs, just to sate the paltry whims of an unsought guest such as yourself?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: So sit down, and let's have a chat. With everything said and done, I think I deserve at least this much, right?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: My goal is simple: Help the IPC retrieve some things that belonged to them in the first place. If you agree, when this is done, you will stand to reap great rewards, as well as the Preservation's protection.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It's clear you're not just one of the crowd. You possess a distinct quality, so magnetic that it could sway the outcome of any game. That *power*, you really don't wish to use it? Or... you don't want to be rid of it? Why not use it to etch your name across the stars?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The power that men both fear and desire is right in the palms of your hands...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...{M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Stellaron, have I hit the nail on the head?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Of course, you can confer with your colleagues as well, or go as far as to use me in turn — I welcome that notion. Because it will also show me your true value.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I don't do deals where I'm on the losing end. So, I hope that "friends"... don't let me down.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Ding— A chip is tossed into the air, and in the blink of an eye, it disappears, replaced by two clenched fists held out in front of you.

rows.text: ...Oh, I didn't get your answer. But that's fine, because...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: What is it, Ratio? Why the long face... Hey, I just realized, where's that handsome bust of yours?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're late, by four minutes and sixteen seconds. You'd better have solved the mystery of Akivili's fall. Otherwise, I'd suggest not tangling with the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: You mean you don't believe me when I say I truly wish to befriend them?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Clamorous people do not make friends. Fun fact: The Attini Peacock boasts one of the universe's more jarring songs, and your choice of attire is somewhat peacock-esque.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: ...It seems this peacock is short of a feather or two. The Family's been rummaging through your things, haven't they?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Yeah, by that gray-suited fellow. All the cash gifts, and the box containing the Cornerstones... Eh? Where're you going?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Back home, to tell the corporation that some idiot ruined everything.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: It's nothing more than a few rocks, why so serious? Who cares if they're gone?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Without that aventurine stone, you're nothing more than a doomed Sigonian thrall sentenced to die by the IPC. Or is that serial number on your neck a cherished memento from the Amber Lord?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: ...Hah, you're funny, I'll give you that! It appears our erudite friend has done his homework.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It's my job. How would a gambler wrest {RUBY_B#Frontier Prison}Penacony{RUBY_E#} back for the IPC otherwise?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Don't worry, Doctor, I have my ways. The Family fears interference from the IPC, hence their constant intervention... Or, to play devil's advocate, perhaps Penacony might have always been a ruse under the guise of "the Harmony?"
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: If you ask me, that invite is nothing but a self-planted diversion, a red herring. Or maybe they're thinking of pulling off something big during the Charmony Festival...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Or someone else made the invite, and they acquiesced to elevating the magnitude of the plan. Regardless — be it The Family or the Watchmaker's Legacy, as long as they're all useful to me.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Get to the point. What's your plan?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: No need to expand on that now. It's not yet time to reveal my trump card.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Damned gambler. Any true collaboration demands trust. Did that notion somehow escape your Sigonian upbringing?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Then, do you trust me?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: That depends on you.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: So you don't trust me either. Now that was easy, wasn't it? Also, I didn't go to school, and my parents didn't teach me any of that. A pity, they left before they could impart any life lessons.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...I did not mean to offend.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: I'm not offended. But they did teach me that friends are weapons of the Avgins. Even under the watchful eye of the Harmony, we need as many friends as we can get.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Let's see, the Garden of Recollection and the Astral Express have already made contact. The Annihilation Gang... I can't really count on them. The Knights of Beauty haven't given their answer, and as for that bunch at the Tavern...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Speaking of which, I ran into a woman just now who introduced herself as a Galaxy Ranger. The whole conversation felt off. Help me look into her...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Huh?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...You don't really disdain me that much, do you? Well, seems like I'm on my own again.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It's just that right now, we're on the eve of the Charmony Festival, Penacony's most important moment of every era. And with The Family's invite, all guests from all over the cosmos have thronged this place...

Hotel security is on high alert, with zero room for error. And with such a last minute change, it really isn't something that this young lady's words can resolve on a whim. My esteemed guests from the Astral Express, please do not make it harder for her.
We're sorry for all the trouble our check-in seems to have caused. Might I ask for your name?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I am the humble Aventurine of the IPC's Strategic Investment Department, a Non-Performing Asset Liquidation Specialist and subordinate to supervisor Diamond. I was cordially invited by the Watchmaker...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I also happen to be a traveler that's had to stand behind you for quite a while.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Leave it to me.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I've heard that the IPC has also received Penacony's invitation, so forgive me if I'm mistaken, but you must be the representative. The IPC's elite certainly does have an extraordinary air about them. I suppose such an exceptional figure such as yourself wouldn't mind paving a convenience for us?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I must be hearing things: Paving a convenience? Shouldn't I be saying this to you instead?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I've been waiting here for more than ten minutes. Do you know how many credits ten minutes is worth to me?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It must be an inordinate number, which is why, now, Mr. Aventurine, I have an investment that you absolutely cannot miss out on.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The IPC's influence runs deep and wide, and their word wields the utmost authority. We hope to borrow your status to vouch for {M#him}{F#her}.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As such, you won't just be sparing much of your invaluable time but also forging new friendships.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Well, this is interesting. And how will my new friends benefit me?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Now this is a topic very much worth getting into. Just as we are guests of the Watchmaker, why don't we make ourselves comfortable in Penacony before getting to know each other more elaborately?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Sounds good. But Ms. Navigator, I must point out that—
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: If I do something about it now, the time saved is from my own effort, not a favor from you all.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...But what you said in the second half, I loved it! Friends, yes — nothing is more precious than friends, especially a righteous Trailblazer like a Nameless.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Going forward on this Penacony trip, I'll be counting on all my "Trailblazer" friends here. Looking forward to a delightful time with you all.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'm glad you've put it this way. So about the vouching...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: There you go, Miss. Please allow {M#him}{F#her} to check in on my account.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I've kept you waiting, Mr. Aventurine. This way please, let us speak in private.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Ah, you're here! Wonderful!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Oh, I... I thought you wouldn't notice me...
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: (So this is... the Dreamscape?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (The atmosphere here creeps me out, and... what was that weird noise just now?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: We meet again.
This whole place looks weird.
Huh, you remember me? I'm so glad.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: This is a temporary interchange, so it looks a little rundown... The Reverie in the dreamscape is currently undergoing a revamp.
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: I apologize for any unpleasantness in your stay... but if you enter the Golden Hour, I'm sure all your troubles will dissipate in an instant!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: What happened to The Reverie?
What is "Golden Hour?"
I just picked up a note...
How do I get to Golden Hour?
You're asking about The Reverie in the dreamscape, right? I'm not sure exactly either, I'm sorry...
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: You've perhaps read about it in your Dreamscape Pass, but I can explain one more time!

rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: ...Ah, but that doesn't mean that time has stopped in the dream. To avoid any physical or mental burden on guests, time in the dream has been synced with reality's, so don't worry!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Note? Did you find it in the room?
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Ah... It wasn't trash left behind by the previous guest, was it...?
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: It was my mistake — I failed to tidy up properly, and caused an inconvenience for you... I'm truly sorry!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: You just go right through that door to reach Golden Hour. I wish you an unforgettable dream!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: Right through that doorway is Golden Hour. If you've any other questions, I'm more than happy to answer them!
rows.speaker: Misha

rows.text: What happened to The Reverie?
What is "Golden Hour?"
I've nothing else to ask, thank you.

What do all these have to do with Akivili?
That's it?
Haha, this dream bubble aligns with what you desire in your subconscious! If you're interested in experiencing the dream bubble again, you can purchase it with credits...
rows.speaker: Dr. Edward

So that "first dream bubble for free" was just a sales pitch, huh?
This dream bubble is indeed pricey. Still, please give it some consideration!

rows.text: This dream bubble is indeed pricey. Still, please give it some consideration!

I can't go about my day without drinking it.
"Grab a bottle of SoulGlad, and make your dreams a blast!"
"What are the benefits of SoulGlad? Whoever gets it right wins this!"
"SoulGlad — the source of joy, the quintessence of dreams!"
The golden drink erupts like a volcano. SoulGlad seems to love this advertising design, and even their factory is designed this way.

"Always the trendsetter — Epirus Apparel Fashion Show."
"Clothes make the man. Shop till you drop at the Epirus Apparel Fashion Show."
The products of this fashion store are said to be capable of making anyone look good.
Mr. Herring's rides the waves with your taste buds! Come on and try Mr. Herring's Lemon Tarts!

rows.text: Are you bothered by the herring in the picture? Fret not. We've stopped using it a long time ago.
rows.speaker: Mr. Herring Billboard

rows.text: It seems kind of weird...
If you're interested in trying our products, you can visit the grocery store in your neighborhood!
rows.speaker: Mr. Herring Billboard

rows.text: "Mr. Herring's rides the waves with your taste buds!"
"I taste so much better than how I smell."
You can still find this product on the shelf now, but herring has been removed from the recipe.
The Bloodhound Family are the guards of the Dreamscape. We're in charge of the security here, and our duties include arresting people who try to enter our world illegally.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Thank you so much!
I... I understand. It's only right to return the favors I receive!
You're funny.
By the way, I've just noticed... You're a Nameless, right? Is this your first time here on Penacony?
You have the Astral Express badge on you. I saw it on the big screen once!
You bet! The Interastral Peace Broadcast recently did a whole segment about your glorious achievements!
That's not what I meant. Though I do admire the Nameless...
Although the Bloodhounds mistook me for a stowaway, I'm actually a local. My name is Firefly, and I'm from the Iris Family. I work as a stage performer, although right now I'm just an extra...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Glad to hear that. After all, you just did me a huge favor!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I'm not booked for any performances, and most visitors to Penacony don't need tour guides anyway... They're all big shots who have their own entourage with them.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Thanks. Let's go!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: No, it's not like that! Penacony is where people realize their dreams. There's always a festive atmosphere here! It's just that things can get a little crazy with the Charmony Festival drawing near...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Glad to hear that. After all, you just did me a huge favor!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Me? No, I'm not one of them — not yet. I merely work for them...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Hey, look! She has an accomplice!
Sorry for all the trouble you went through back there.
I'm Gallagher from the Bloodhound Family, and those idiots are some young Bloodhounds I've been training.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Because of their youth and inexperience, they mistook an honored guest of Penacony for a criminal... This is indeed a regrettable mistake. I'd like to offer my sincerest apology to you on behalf of the Bloodhound Family.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: We got a tip that some criminals were planning to take advantage of the festivities around the Charmony Festival to sneak into Penacony. Now that the festival is just around the corner, there are likely many shady characters lurking around...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Don't worry. I believe this is just a misunderstanding. How could such a lovely girl like you be a stowaway?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Thanks. Without your kind help, I wouldn't know what to do.
Just part of the job.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I need to get going. If you need help, you can reach out to me through the young Bloodhounds in this area. I wish you an enjoyable experience in this land of dreams.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I owe you a big one! If it hadn't been for you, I might have been... taken away by them.
I also know that you guys often travel around different places in the cosmos. Did The Family invite you here? I—I'd be happy to show you around!
I also know that you guys often travel around different places in the cosmos. Did The Family invite you here? I—I'd be happy to show you around!
The Family invited you here, right? I—I'd be happy to show you around!

When there are no acting gigs, I work as a guide near Glaux Avenue. If you don't mind, I can show you all the exciting things around here! Maybe if I do my job as a guide, people will stop suspecting me...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You notice her lowering her lashes and looking around, paying close attention to the crowd, as if something is hiding in it. But she quickly collects herself and returns her eyes to you.
...We can talk about that another time! Right now, I wanna give you a tour of the town... Here we go!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Don't even think about running away, you stowaway!
S—Sorry for bothering you! Please, I need your help...
Good work! Now we can nab them both in one go!
That's enough, boys.
S—Sir?
What's gotten into you all? Open your eyes and take a good look. Is this lady the stowaway we're looking for?
Eh? Who... Who's this?
Don't you know him? Look at his brown hair and gray vest. He's the officer sent here by The Family to maintain order at the Charmony Festival.
I—I see... Sir, the thing is, we're trying to apprehend a stowaway, and that young lady there looks very suspicious. We're sure she's the one!

That's nonsense. Take another look, will you? The witness report says that the suspect is a lad with silver hair, and you guys are going after a girl with silver hair. Does that even make sense? She's our guest!
Well, just get out of my way and I'll take care of this.
Yes, sir!
Thanks. That's very nice of you!
You shouldn't have!
I should warn you, I do have very expensive tastes...
He looks cute.
His character design is a little... surrealist.
Isn't having a clock as a character a bit... ominous?
Watchmaker?
Is he famous?
Thanks.
I think I'll pass. I'm allergic to camera lenses...
Aha, I know how this goes. You're gonna charge me a lot just for taking the pic, aren't you?
I rescued a bird — a bird with sharp edges and points.
I pulled out his eyelashes.
I can actually jump in this world!? Color me surprised!
What's up?
What are you looking at?
We're here. Hey, have you ever heard of this saying that goes, "In a dream, hunger is the most precious spice?"

rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Hee-hee, you're welcome.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: No worries. You can buy me a meal next time!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Th—That shouldn't be a problem. I have some savings left...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Are you done ordering? Then I'll pay up.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I love their Oak Cake Rolls! I get one from here every day!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Doesn't that get expensive?
Aren't those high in calories?
Well, that's why I only have one per day...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I—I won't put on any weight since this is all a dream...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Let's walk while we eat. It's time to head to the next stop!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Look! That's the statue of Clockie, Penacony's famous cartoon character!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It's the oldest and most famous animation from Penacony. It follows the adventurous life of Clockie and his friends in the town of Dreamville. To date, over 10,000 episodes have aired!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I know, right? Isn't he adorable?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Um... I guess it's because the animation has a retro style.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Ominous? Clockie is a household name here. There would never be anything ominous about him... right?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: By the way, do you know that Clockie's design is said to be inspired by none other than the legendary Watchmaker?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I can't believe you haven't heard of him. He was a legendary tycoon in the history of Penacony — the founder of the Dreamscape, the man who turned dreams into reality!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: There are different stories out there about the Watchmaker's origin. Some said he was a traveling merchant from beyond the sky, some claimed that he was exiled to Penacony as a prisoner... Some speculate that he wasn't even a real person, just a symbol...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The true story is anyone's guess, but everyone aspires to emulate his success and be the next Watchmaker!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: As his inspiring story became known across the cosmos, those with a dream flocked to Penacony in droves. They held feast after feast, eventually building the Planet of Festivities we have today. Everyone in Penacony knows this name.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The cartoon character Clockie is portrayed as reckless and full of hot air, but I believe the real Watchmaker was a Nameless! After all, creating the Dreamscape sounds like just the kind of thing a Trailblazer would do.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...Hold on... If the Watchmaker really was a Nameless, wouldn't that make him your predecessor? Would you like to take a picture with him?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: My pleasure! Here, give me your phone.

rows.text: I see... Let's go somewhere else then.

rows.text: He's our king, as well as the manager of all the waste in this world. Perched on his throne, he uplifts trashcans that are humble and suppresses those that are violent. He's the cornerstone of Belobog, the lid that secures us, the barrel that reinforces us.
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: However, since the thing from beyond the sky arrived here along with the Eternal Freeze, Tatalov's eyes have been blinded. He stopped listening to our calls, leaving the impoverished to be bullied and his loyal servants to be degraded...
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: A change was overdue, as the humiliation was too much for us. We intended to help Tatalov mend his ways under the banner of the Skyfire...
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: The humiliation was too much for us. We intended to help Garbage King mend his ways under the banner of the Skyfire... But we were no match for the sinister king, who spread vicious rumors among the trashcans to divide us against each other. As a result, we could no longer communicate with one another using {RUBY_B#Heart}trashbags{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: ...I implore your help to restore peace to the trash bags, so that the trashcans here may be united once more. Then, we'll be able to launch a counterattack against that undeserving king.
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: (I think that's what she means...)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (I think she's trying to say that you're the only one who can unite these, uhm, trashcans and lead their battle against the evil king... or something like that.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Well, that seals the deal.
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: (Dr. Edward said he didn't have the time to make any alternative storylines. Just accept it.)
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You have one mission — help the trashcans with their troubles and collect three Proofs of Trust.
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: Once you've accomplished that, you'll become our new king and lead our fight against the evil king. Off you go, dream diver... Your mission is calling for you.
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: Impressive... It's hard to believe you've collected all the Proofs of Trust. Your determination is truly admirable...
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: ...I've waited so long for this day. Here, I'll escort you to your throne, the Pillars of Creation, where you'll witness the future of my people...
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: I wish you success.
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: Excellent. Looks like you've held up your side of the deal...
rows.speaker: Shatana

rows.text: (...Didn't they say the Garbage King would wait for me here?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Have I been set up?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: A strange trash bag sits in the bottomless trashcan. You notice the "seal" on the bag — A few fish bones have clipped the mouth of the bag shut.
Remove the seal.
Bam! Green smoke wafts up from within the bag together with a loud noise. It twists and congeals in the air, slowly becoming a giant... trashcan.
Finally — I am free! I am "Garboski," a can of unmatched evil. Tatalov used despicable means to defeat me and sealed me in this deep and cramped trash bag.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: For the first five hundred years of my imprisonment, I swore an oath that if a can came to save me, I would reward them with endless wealth. Then, for the next five hundred years, I swore that if a can saved me, I would reward them with endless trash.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: However, ten thousand years have passed. That's 20 five-hundred-year periods, but no cans came! Therefore, I swore that if a can came to save me, I would reward them with a painless death.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: — You've come, and so you now must die.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: This is not fair! I saved you!
But I'm a person, not a trashcan.
Correct. I will now offer you a final mercy. You get to choose how you wish to die.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: I wish to die as a warrior!
I don't believe you were sealed in the trash bag.
Oh? No trashcan has ever dared to challenge me to a duel. I acknowledge your bravery... Perhaps there's no need to conduct a pointless battle.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: Why not stand with me against Tatalov?
Countless years of captivity have whittled flat my edges. My prime is long past, never to return. I only wish to pass the rest of my life as a normal trashcan. Farewell, stranger.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: Ah, yes, Tatalov used the same trick against me. "With such a massive body like yours, how can a bag fit you?" And so I slipped into a trash bag before him and found myself sealed.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: Even the vilest trashcan is capable of learning to heed a lesson. Your tactics are ineffective against me now! Now, feel my ten thousand years — five hundred years times twenty — of fury!
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: You're right. You are not the savior that I expected. And because you haven't betrayed my expectations... I should thank you instead. Go. I won't take your life, but that's the limit of my mercy.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: Why not stand with me against Tatalov?
Countless years of captivity have whittled flat my edges. My prime is long past, never to return. I only wish to pass the rest of my life as a normal trashcan. Farewell, stranger.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: You dealt with the sealed demon, Garboski? He is so powerful and so terrifying, but you defeated him... How magnificent of you!
rows.speaker: Audience Can

rows.text: You've won me over, along with many others. This item carries our high regard for you.
rows.speaker: Audience Can

rows.text: This is a normal-looking trashcan. How magical! A kingdom of trashcans actually has an ordinary trashcan... This is a rare opportunity. Do you wish to do something to it?
Insert trash.
Remove some trash.
Give it a kick.
Of course. That's the job of a trashcan. You chuck whatever random things you have on hand into its pitch-black and bottomless void. A series of loud sounds thundered back.
Of course. That's the value of a trashcan. When you used your finger to touch its sides, a burst of loud sounds followed.

...Evidently, this is not civilized behavior. In regular circumstances, you'd probably have to give up a Praise of High Morals... However, this is the Dreamscape, so who cares? You feel your foot impact the can with a loud bam...
When you open your eyes again, the trashcan is no longer just a trashcan. It's now a trashcan... with arms and legs.
Thank you, beautiful stranger. I am the Trashcan Prince, and my father was assassinated by Tatalov, and I was cursed into becoming a trashcan. You saved me from internment.
rows.speaker: Trashcan Prince

rows.text: I shall offer everything I have — my body, my soul, my life, even my trash bags — just to repay your kindness.
rows.speaker: Trashcan Prince

rows.text: You talk like a Knight of Beauty...
Then stand with me against Tatalov.

There are many cans who compliment my beauty, but I am not familiar with the name of which you just spoke. The only knightly order in this kingdom is the "Knights of Loose Change," each of whom is a noble and respectable can of the highest order.
rows.speaker: Trashcan Prince

rows.text: I will. I will stand with you and ignite the rising smoke of rebellion until the kingdom is saved from absolute peril.
rows.speaker: Trashcan Prince

rows.text: You have earned my confidence. I wish for you to accept this item and my heart as a token of my sincere gratitude. I will fight for you, O glorious soul.
rows.speaker: Trashcan Prince

rows.text: Three trashcans stand around each other, arguing ceaselessly about a certain matter...
Outlander, a dispute awaits your fair judgment.
rows.speaker: Serious Can

rows.text: This is the legendary golden trash, a symbol of power and status. Only the most qualified trashcan may lay claim to it. All of us feel that we are that trashcan, and so we keep fighting for it.
rows.speaker: Beautiful Can

rows.text: So, we have decided that an observer possessing unique and just insight should be the judge for this matter and decide to whom the reward will belong, and bring a conclusive end to this long dispute.
rows.speaker: Wise Can

rows.text: If you give the golden trash to me, I will pledge you endless wealth, more than enough to fill the biggest trashcan there is.
rows.speaker: Serious Can

rows.text: If you give the golden trash to me, I will grant you endless knowledge, more than any full bag of trashcan provide.
rows.speaker: Wise Can

rows.text: If you bestow upon me this golden trash, I shall promise you the most beautiful trashcan in the world — myself. I will stand beside you as a partner beyond peer and face all your trials and triumphs by your side.
rows.speaker: Beautiful Can

rows.text: So... what is your choice?
Split golden trash into three and distribute evenly.
I am the only one worthy of it!
Amidst the watchful gaze of the three, you perfectly split the golden trash. Not even a Clockie Pizza can be divided this evenly.
The conundrum that has stymied us for so long... fixed just like that?
rows.speaker: Wise Can

rows.text: Then who is the most qualified can... No, that no longer mattered.
rows.speaker: Beautiful Can

rows.text: The outlander must be trying to help us understand how foolish this dispute of ours was... You have proven yourself with your actions. This signifies our loyalty and longing. We wish for you to have it.
rows.speaker: Serious Can

rows.text: Under the watchful eyes of the three, you claim the golden trash as your own. Indeed, among these small trashcans, is there anyone who stands as tall and upright as you do?
The conundrum that has stymied us for so long... fixed just like that?
rows.speaker: Wise Can

rows.text: Then who is the most qualified can... No, that no longer mattered.
rows.speaker: Beautiful Can

rows.text: The outlander must be trying to help us understand how foolish this dispute of ours was... You have proven yourself with your actions. This signifies our loyalty and longing. We wish for you to have it.
rows.speaker: Serious Can

rows.text: We've had enough of Tatalov's oppression! To retrieve our belongings from his treasure trove, the resources vital to our livelihoods seized by Tatalov's greed and tyranny, we must open this door.
rows.speaker: Courageous Can

rows.text: Push the door.
Kick the door.
Open sesame!
Strange, you haven't done anything, but the door opens slowly — it turns out that this is an automatic sensor door. It just can't sense trashcans.
The door is open... The legends are true! You are the savior destined to defeat Tatalov! The God of Trash sent you to return the tyrant's treasures to us!
rows.speaker: Courageous Can

rows.text: Ah, I've never felt so exhilarated before! When you raise the banner of rebellion against Tatalov, I and the other oppressed cans shall stand by your side!
rows.speaker: Courageous Can

rows.text: You watch the trashcans excitedly crowd into the "treasure trove," tearing open bag after bag of garbage and pouring the contents into their torso...

This particular trashcan stands quietly. Its lid has chipped and faded paint. It is meticulously counting the roadside trash, occasionally sighing or scratching its head, as if struggling to memorize an astronomical number.
...Are you here to mock me too? Or are you seeking wise answers?
rows.speaker: Trashiemedes

rows.text: Why are you counting trash?
I need "Proof of Trust."

It's a long story. A long, long time ago, I angered Tatalov. I told him that even the most stable of nations has their day of decay, and even all the trash in the stars can eventually be counted. It is unclear which part of the sentence infuriated him...
rows.speaker: Trashiemedes

rows.text: ...As punishment, he assigned me this role, demanding that I count all the trash in the city. Before then, I am to never issue forth my opinions.
rows.speaker: Trashiemedes

rows.text: Oh... it's rare for a can to be so straightforward. I do possess the "Proof of Trust," but now it's lost in the mountain of trash.
rows.speaker: Trashiemedes

rows.text: If you want it, work with me. I have counted the majority of the trash in this city, leaving only these three newly arrived cans.
rows.speaker: Trashiemedes

rows.text: What sort of trash would Trashcan Kingdom hold? Curiosity piqued, you open the lid of the first trashcan.
Unfortunately, there isn't any difference. Maybe Dr. Edward did not have time to attend to these details.

There's a comic book inside this trashcan. The pages are torn and damaged. It tells of an adventure: Tatalov was once a brave trashcan. With valiance and willpower, it defeated a colossal junk monster and saved a human from its monstrous maw.
In order to repay Tatalov, that human turned himself into a trashcan... This is actually a horror story.
You see something unexpected — a True Sting, lying inside the trashcan, looking back at you.
Die, remnants of Propagation!
It is time to rid the people of this menace — Use your bat to tell it that this is a Kingdom of Preservation!
I didn't expect you to be so strong. I acknowledge your bravery... Perhaps there's no need to conduct a pointless battle.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: Why not stand with me against Tatalov?
Countless years of captivity have whittled flat my edges. My prime is long past, never to return. I only wish to pass the rest of my life as a normal trashcan. Farewell, stranger.
rows.speaker: Garboski

rows.text: How can this be opened?
Ninety-seven thousand eight hundred sixty-three...
Then who is worthy of it?
Only I should have it!
This requires further discussion...
(Is this where the final battle will take place... Not sure how I feel about this...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Such a tragic scene...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What's going on?
Are you asking for help?
What kind of thing... are you?
I can see a... clock with limbs.
I think I'm seeing things...
Nothing. It's inconsequential.
The elegant Memokeeper?
Who is she?
This place looks mighty fine.
Is this your secret stronghold?
What a beautiful manhole cover.
Is this... your secret stronghold?
Inside? What does that mean?
Do you want me... to crawl in there?
This is embarrassing. People are watching us...
I saw a dial and got it moving.
I have no clue what I did. You sure I pulled that off?
Um... Thank you?
No need for such formalities. We're... a Family!
You may rise.
I appreciate the gesture...
...But, can we have some privacy, please?
I saw a dial and got it moving.
I have no clue what I did. You sure I pulled that off?
It's the least I can do.
Wow, you've become so well-mannered.
Everyone loses it once in a while.
Perhaps, it's because we're all in a dream.
It's Boss Stone's doing. Can you believe it?
I appreciate the gesture...
...But, can we have some privacy, please?
I saw a dial and got it moving.
I have no clue what I did. You sure I pulled that off?
What's wrong sweetie? Why are you feeling so down?
Bruh, quit the waterworks. You're a big boy now.
Oh dear me, ain't I a big bad meanie for making you sob like a crybaby?
My friend, why don't you go and...
How about you get some alone time somewhere?
Clockie, how can I help?
Clockie? Are you a cartoon character?
A talking clock? I must be losing my mind.
Yes, I saw him.
I'm not hallucinating... right?
Can't you see him?
He said only children can see him.
He said you weren't innocent, kind... or honest.
He's begging for my help...
He says someone's life is in danger...
Please fill me in on what's going on first.
What should I do to help him?
My baseball bat can't wait to show its might!
What is "Clockwork"?
Are you sure about this...
Why don't you do it yourself?
No need to thank me. It's the least I can do.
I'm surprised too.
Clockie taught me some Clockwork.
Talk therapy. I used that on him.
It's only natural for people to get intimidated by my baseball bat.
Tick-tock! Help! Help me!
Someone's dying! Please come here!
Didn't I make myself clear? Someone is dying! Please help!
Yes, yes! Please help! Someone's life is in your hands!
I'm not some random thing, I'm a clock!
Wait... Can you... see me?
...Is there a problem?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Can you really see me?
Tick-tock! Wonderful! This is awesome! There's still hope for Misha!
Eh, can you see me too?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: I can feel the presence of something inexplicable next to you, but it's a shame that I can't communicate with him like you can.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We can both perceive these extraordinary things in the dream, probably due to our ability to react to memoria. But you're more attuned to it than I am.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I thought your heightened perception was caused by something the elegant Memokeeper might have left in your mind. Now, it seems to me there are many more special beings like her in this dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's a shame that I forgot to ask her for her name. I only know that she's from the Garden of Recollection.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Garden of Recollection... Is it the group that serves the Aeon of Remembrance?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Exactly. They traverse freely between different worlds as memetic entities and are only visible to certain people. Doesn't she sound very much like that Clockie you saw?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: After all, it is a grand event held by The Family. The guestlist could be a lot longer than we imagine.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Once again, thank you for being kind to me. I wish you a great time in the dream, and I shall not interrupt your... date?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: N—No! We're not on a date!
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Hehe.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Shortly after we parted ways, I wandered into a ball without realizing it. A lady wearing a black veil invited me to dance. It was my first dance, and it was an unforgettable experience.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Shortly after we parted ways, I met a lady wearing a black veil who was also a guest at the hotel. We had a good time talking about the event over drinks.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Shortly after we parted ways, I felt someone's spying eyes on me. I looked in the mirror and spotted a lady wearing a black veil. We had a deep conversation, but I won't bore you with the details.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Here we are. This is the place.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: No, it isn't...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...This is.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Yes, it's right inside.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Just the literal meaning.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It doesn't matter! Anything can happen in a dream, and there are lots of people falling from the sky every day. The pedestrians aren't going to be fazed by anything.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Let me show you how to do it. It's going to be very dark at first, so you'll have to stay close to me.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...Hahahahaha!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: You did it! But how did he end up like this?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Here comes the Clockwork!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: It... must have been? It's rather out of character for him to start cracking up like that all of a sudden.
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: It's just that... seeing that gleeful smile on his face... he's just as scary as he was before.
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Hello, everyone! Please allow me to welcome all of you to Penacony, Land of the Dreams!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Come on now, line up and give our honored guests a warm welcome!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: S—Sure!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Ready... Go!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Welcome to Penacony, Land of the Dreams!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: It's my honor! It's only right we give guests a proper welcome!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: You're welcome!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: You're right! We're a family to THEM!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: We're a family!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: We're at your disposal! You're our most distinguished guest!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Your happiness is our priority!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Wow! Seems like you've established yourself as an important figure around here. In that case, can you ask them to leave now?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Sure thing! You're the boss... Gang, let's give our VIP some space!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Yes, boss!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: ...What got into me just now?
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Hey, he seems normal now. That's wonderful! You did it!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Great! It means you've mastered the art of Clockwork!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: It... must have been? Otherwise, why would he suddenly be all calm and composed like this?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Was I... about to get into a fight with that lady? Was I crazy?
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: What's wrong with boss?
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Hey, may I ask you a question? Were you the one who made me simmer down earlier? I wasn't my normal self..
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Thanks for doing that. If we'd laid a finger on our guests just now, we would've faced severe punishment from the Bloodhound Family.
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: We owe it to you — if we'd laid a finger on our guests just now, we would've faced severe punishment from the Bloodhound Family.
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: I'm so sorry for stirring up all this trouble... Alas, why did I get so worked up all of a sudden? It's baffling...
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Oh, my gray friend! You have to tell him that {RUBY_B#Boss}Stone{RUBY_E#} is behind this!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: This is embarrassing... I feel bad for causing such a spectacle.
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Haha, that can be one of the reasons.
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Stone? Um, I'm not sure I get what you mean...
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Anyway, I owe everyone a proper apology. Gang, line up and say sorry to our honored guests!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: S—Sure!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Ready... Go!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: We're truly sorry for the trouble we caused!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Wow, they look really sincere. In that case, can you ask them to leave now?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Sure thing! You're the boss... Gang, let's give our VIP some space!
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Yes, boss!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Oh, goodness! Did you make him cry?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Great! It means you've mastered the art of Clockwork!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: It... must have been? Otherwise, why would he be in tears all of a sudden?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: What's wrong with boss?
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Oh, he's crying so hard. Even I, the guardian of the Dreamville, am nearly moved to tears.
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: *sob*... I... thought about my mother on my home planet...
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: *sob*... I... thought about my mother on my home planet...
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: *sob*... It isn't your fault. I just suddenly... thought about my mother on my home planet...
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: What do we do now?
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Woah, things are turning into a mess. But then again, maybe now is a good chance to ask them to leave?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: *sob*... You're right...
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: *sob*... Gang, you are dismissed... I need to be alone for a while...
rows.speaker: Gangster Boss

rows.text: Yes, boss!
rows.speaker: Gang Members

rows.text: Oops, I haven't introduced myself!
My name is Clockie. I'm a famous celebrity in Penacony! My friends and I keep the peace in this small town. They are Hanu, Mr. Soda, Origami Bird, Hamster Ball Knight...
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: ...And Misha! Misha is in trouble! Tick-tock! Help! Help!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: A clock that talks?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...Clockie?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Do you mean... you saw a cartoon character that doesn't exist in real life?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Tick-tock, I'm really here! As the humble face of Penacony, I never ever brag!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Um... Where's he? I can't see him...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Tick-tock! I guess I'm only visible to those with the innocence, kindness, and honesty of a child, like this kid here clad in gray!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Um, but I think you look older than me in terms of appearance...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...Just how so!?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Tick-tock, tick-tock! My gray friend, since you can see, then you must be able to help me!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: My friend, Misha, is in trouble! I'm begging you to help him before it's too late!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Huh...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Uh... Is it really that bad...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Are you going to help this... um, Clockie that only you can see?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I don't think you're lying, as anything can happen in a dream... We can just head to the place I mentioned later...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Tick-tock, tick-tock! Hurry up and follow me, gray friend!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Misha's in trouble! He's over there. Let me bring you to him!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: (The name of Misha rings a bell to me... Anyway, better check out what's going on.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Tick-tock! I'm begging you, my gray friend, begging you! Please help Misha!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Are you talking to Clockie? ...Hmm, I'm really curious too...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Are you talking to Clockie? ..Well, it does look like things are getting out of control...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I'm afraid a baseball bat isn't an efficient weapon... No! What I mean is, we can't solve the problem with violence...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Tick-tock, tick-tock! It's all {RUBY_B#Boss}Stone{RUBY_E#}'s fault that things have turned out this way!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Of all the lowlifes in Dreamville, {RUBY_B#Boss}Stone{RUBY_E#}'s the worst. He's a greedy man who wants to drive everyone out of Dreamville so that he can have all the precious stones to himself...
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: He instructed his underlings to wreak havoc in the Dreamscape, taking away everyone's positive emotions! Since then, the town has been filled with anxiety and disputes! We're no longer a family!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: As the guardian of Dreamville, I can't just sit back and do nothing. By using the power of Clockwork, I can direct the flow of positive emotions in the Dreamscape back into people's hearts — that way, everyone can patch up their differences and get along again!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: My gray friend, I require your assistance! I have a feeling you'll be able to master the power of Clockwork! After all, you're the special one who can see me!
