rows.text: These words have been appearing and then vanishing persistently for awhile now. Whose thoughts are they? And who is this Mikhail...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It's like I can feel... emotions contained within them. Confusion... fear... sadness... and others so faint I can barely feel them...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Unyielding resolve in the face of death...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...What's going on!? The lights have all turned on. So creepy...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: But, since there are so many doors here... we should be able to leave through one of them...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Come to think of it, I wonder if I have to go to the hotel to return to reality...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (...Strange, where's everyone gone?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Sampo? Is that guy up to no good again?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (This is too weird...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (...Firefly?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: We can't get through here. Let's take the way around from the side.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Mikhail...?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: That was a close one... but we made it.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: So strange... The Family insist that the Dreamscape is absolutely safe.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: There's nothing but... a jigsaw puzzle here.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The pieces look like they flew to both sides of the room.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Take it with you, Mikhail!
It will protect you from harm.
Just like they did with Clockie...
I promise you, Mikhail...
So, you need to keep yourself safe, too...
Okay, Mikhail?
Er... Just one chest? I'm sure that's not a trap. Should we open it...?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Dead-end here too... Given the layout of the room, are they really suggesting we maneuver around using the walls?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...The exact same room?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ██Help█ ███ █ help ██...
This again... No wait, could it be...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: █said███do█not█ ██ █open the box██...
Uh oh... Which one was the original door?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: █beg█you██ █I████ ███ █scared█...
Can't believe that worked. Tampering with the Dreamscape's gravity is clearly strictly forbidden...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...Careful, there are some strange things on the wall... And they don't look like they're from the Dreamjolt Troupe...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I... don't know.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I'm not sure. Everything happened so quickly. But regardless, The Family must be hiding something — something about the truth of the Dreamscape...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I'm not sure. Everything happened so quickly. But regardless, The Family must be hiding something — something about the truth of the Dreamscape...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I should've been wary of him sooner... Sorry. Regardless, The Family must be hiding something — something about the truth behind the Dreamscape...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: And, you probably noticed it when you woke up as well — the ticking of clocks all around us... My gut tells me that the secret hidden here is also linked to that mysterious Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I didn't do much, just helped you leave the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Welcome to reality. More specifically, The Reverie, the safest and most familiar place you can be.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I know you've many questions, so please compose yourself. Before that, you should let your friends know you're safe.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Heheh, you're quite concerned about that young lady. That's fair — she was hell-bent on assuring your safety even at the brink of death... Started to tug a little at my heartstrings, even.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: (Ugh... This... What is this place?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (I'm back at the hotel? No, this feeling... The surroundings look a little like I just entered a dream...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah... [Trailblazer]! So you're really here too...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: In any case, we must still be in a dream. It can't be anywhere else, much less reality... I'm never wrong about the distinctive sense of memoria that's in the air.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: But this is very different from the "sweet dream" that I'm familiar with — suffocating... silent... uneasy... And these floating words. Can you see them too? This kind of place would never exist on Penacony under the provision of The Family. So, could this be a dream bubble...?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: No, that's not right. Do you remember, before we were unconscious, that friend of yours said: The real {RUBY_B#Penacony}Dreamscape{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: If it points us towards the Watchmaker's Legacy, it will be connected to everyone who is melded to Penacony's dream...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Let's go, [Trailblazer]... We have to move — be it to find an exit, or the truth.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You're awake, lazy bug. Looks like you had a nice dream.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: How was it? Did you dream of me?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'm happy to see that you've kept your wits, and that you haven't been affected by the *Primal Dreamscape*. How lucky.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We meet again, my dear...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: It looks like you have not taken my warnings to heart... A pity. Are you so enchanted by that girl?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You're just so... blind.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...Careful. I'm more than certain now that there's something not right about this friend of yours.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Oho, this brave little girl appears to be protecting you. I wonder why? Are you two that close?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You talk too much.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I love your attitude, my dear. I have to admit you're different from your friend here — your senses are much sharper.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Even so, you are lagging far behind the main party. Have you not noticed yet? What The Family is hiding, the secret behind this sweet dream.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: And as for you — the Trailblazer who saved the Ice World... I wonder how many things Sampo glossed over when recounting the happenings on Jarilo-VI? Oh well, it was my problem for trusting him...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...I'm really, really disappointed in you.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: (We'll be busy for a while. I wonder if Firefly's returned to reality yet...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (...Hmm, I don't have her contact info, I'll ask Black Swan...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Miss Acheron, I have a suggestion: Why not split up and look for a way out, and meet up again when we find something? That would speed things up.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But it's dangerous around here. We'd better travel together.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: How about it? Can you feel the memoria flowing around you?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Next, find a suitable spot... and try *walking up* the wall.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Let's go.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This way, follow me.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You... lost your way again?
You... know each other?
Never hurts to have more people.
We can trust Acheron.
I think we should forget it...
No, absolutely not.
I mean, no problem.
I mean, no can do...
I mean, no problem.
I mean, no problem.
I mean, no problem.
I mean, no can do.
I mean, no problem.
I mean, no problem.
That's true.
I can.
How about in front of me?
Firefly? What's she doing here?
Could you be mistaken?
You said she already returned to reality.
Clocks...
Fish...
The deep sea...
Your memories tell you this is March 7th's room. Unless fate intervenes, she will "awaken" here.
March, are you there?
You knock, but there's no response...
Are you in there? We are about to set off.
You knock again, but there's no response...
March? It's me, [Trailblazer]...
You knock harder, and there's still no response.
I know what you're thinking, but alas... That girl isn't in there, and neither is this her room.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The moment you stepped into the Memory Zone, reality's building structures lost all meaning. I can sense that she is in a faraway place right now.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: In the meantime, if we want to find that lobby the Navigator mentioned... we'll have to try a little harder.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: What's wrong? Are you not feeling well?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I feel fine.
I don't feel so good...
That's good then.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I know you're more sensitive to memoria, thus more easily affected by the Dreamscape than others. This is also why I have to accompany you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I shall use my methods to relieve you. Don't worry, as your companions are safe — I had both of them each give me a trinket before I entered the dream. This will allow me to feel their presence in the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: They're already awake in their rooms. Will you be comfortable in following me now? Time waits for no one. We must hurry to the lobby.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Are there... no staff members here at all?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Huh? What're you doing here?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Well, not really. I just don't know where I am.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Yes. She is the Memokeeper I mentioned.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We'll have to cut the banter short... Let's first work together and remove these overly friendly children, shall we?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'm indebted to you both for your help.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Finally, some peace and quiet. What are the two of you doing here?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We could ask you the same thing.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Is that so... You're good then. What sort of training did you have to undergo? Can you teach me?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: {M#He}{F#She}'s kidding. {M#He}{F#She} can't do it.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That's not what I meant. It's just a... figure of speech.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Your arrival is timely — this Dreamscape is fraught with danger. Since our destination is the same, how about we join forces?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I can protect you from harm, but in the Memory Zone, I'll need assistance from the Memokeeper as well. And... if we run into The Family, it wouldn't hurt to have one more person to explain the situation.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Hmm... What do you think, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Sorry. I couldn't hear you clearly. Could you repeat that?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Sorry. I couldn't hear you clearly. Could you repeat that?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: (What's going on? That weird feeling is back again...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Sorry. I couldn't hear you clearly. Could you repeat that?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Sorry. I couldn't hear you clearly. Could you repeat that?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: (What's going on? That weird feeling is back again...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Thank you, [Trailblazer]... I'm truly grateful.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Glad to be traveling with you again, Miss Black Swan.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Mm... I truly hope so.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's a long story. I fortuitously — as {M#he}{F#she} should remember — became friends with some of the Bloodhounds, and was helping them track down a wanted criminal... Except I ended up here for some reason.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's probably not as complicated as it sounds. It's all thanks to... a Masked Fool. Maybe I unwittingly hurt her... and then in a flash of kaleidoscopic light, I ended up here.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Penacony's rife with rumors now, about the Watchmaker, a legacy, nightmares and other mysterious tales. I was curious as to who was spreading them, and tested the method as described in the rumors... To think I actually ended up here...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You... aren't hiding anything, are you?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hiding? I don't think I'd be capable of that in front of a Memokeeper.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This door... can't be opened?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's locked. I can travel through it freely, but you all...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We'll just have to take the way I came. Follow me.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This room... Why is it upside down?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The Memory Zone is constantly shifting its form. Looks like we'll have to think of a way... to walk on the ceiling.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We're standing on the ceiling right now.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Miss Acheron's words speak sense. Regardless, we have to reach that flat surface hanging overhead. And we're not scaling the pillar, of course.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'll teach everyone some traversal tricks used in the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: This door... is locked too?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: There's no end to this. Let me try.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You see the Memokeeper close her eyes. She is searching the room in an almost telepathic way, even every nook and cranny outside the room.
This Memory Zone... is overly twisted. I have to use inelegant methods, so you two... please give me a little time...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Mm... got it. I can see the core of this Dreamscape, and there are members of The Family... and some figures trying to find their way forward. It appears that your friends aren't faring too well... One, two, three...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Wait, three? There is a third person seeking the way to the lobby? Wait... it's...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...The girl who was with you?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It eludes me, but there's a known semblance in the Memory Zone, mirroring the essence she radiates... What reason does she have to delve so deep into the Dreamscape?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: She... Is she running? No... Running away? Something's right behind her...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...This is not good. Everyone, we must hurry.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The gate shuts. Your thoughts, stirred by the swirling current and pulled along, descend into a deep abyss, sinking. When the hatch opens again, what sights will you behold? Perhaps no one can provide an answer.
An indescribable fluid — darkness — flows from your chest to your throat. Suffocation engulfs you from within. Then, a voice emerges...
In my dream, I saw a scorched earth, and a new sapling emerging from it. It bloomed against the morning sun, and whispered to me.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Why do people choose to sleep? I think...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The final sigh escapes, its origin unknown.
...It is because they're afraid to awaken from the dream.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Those Stellaron Hunters... They even factored Penacony into their plan! Nowhere's safe from them!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The situation is clear — the Planet of Festivities isn't what it seems on the surface. Everyone's sights, including the factions in The Family, are set on the Watchmaker's Legacy. Every party has its own motives, and they're attempting to thwart each other.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: While we still don't know what this legacy entails, it's only a matter of time before the power struggle ensnares innocent bystanders.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The Molten Knight, Sam, is reportedly a remnant of Glamoth's Iron Cavalry — a genetically engineered warrior. He possesses superhuman perception and acts decisively — he'll leave no margin for error. This individual is every bit as dangerous as Kafka and Blade.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This message is a threat. The hidden map that Silver Wolf mentioned is probably the sealed dreamscape Hotel. For the sake of what's to come, a visit seems necessary.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Should we inform The Family?
What if we get found out...
It could be a Stellaron Hunter's trap...
We may be on amicable terms, but that doesn't mean they trust us... Let's act first and talk later.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Which is why I didn't suggest it initially. But the way things are now, the Astral Express has a reason to join the fray.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: If The Family asks, just tell them that the Express is investigating the Stellaron Hunters — I'm sure they'll understand. We'll plan our next move according to how they react.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Then we are in agreement. Let's return and inform Miss Black Swan.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You look anxious, [Trailblazer]. Worried about that girl?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You can talk to me if you've something on your mind. In this world, there's no one who heals the heart better than a Memokeeper.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Thank you for saving me.
Can you confirm Firefly is safe?
To be honest, I don't really trust Memokeepers.
You're not returning to your room?
That's all for now.
I just did what I had to do. You are special, after all... So special that many pairs of eyes are watching your every move.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Don't worry. That is a one-way door leading to awakened reality. Unless that girl is so stubborn that she refuses to wake up from the dream — which isn't possible — she must be holed up somewhere in the hotel massaging her eyes right now.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It appears you've had some unhappy memories... But it's obvious that this partnership makes the most sense to you, me, and the Express Crew, no? So you can take it easy and trust me.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Of course, I'm not the only Memokeeper who has come — Penacony has opened its doors to factions beyond The Family for the first time, and the Garden must record this historic moment...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: So you can try working together with others as well... As long as you can see them, hehe.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: No. I will accompany you into the dream to prevent harm from befalling you all. Memokeepers don't need a Dreampool anyway.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: All right. Drift peacefully off to sleep, and I'll be right with you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The Memokeeper hands over a Memory Bubble, signaling for you to press it against your forehead. You do as instructed, and a bone-chilling coldness pierces your body, which then consolidates into a clear image.
You see Himeko and March 7th together, obstructed by The Family. Black Swan stands beside them, unnoticed by the The Family.
I understand the situation now. Please take [Trailblazer] and retreat to a safe location. If time allows, you can investigate Firefly's matter first. Meet later at Clockie's statue.
Memories in the bubbles come to an end here.
Which is why I must undertake Miss Himeko's request and bring both of you back to reality. [Trailblazer]... I'm glad to see that you're fine. Let us reach a safe place before speaking again.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Miss Black Swan, do you not intend to open some sort of... teleporter?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Mm... I don't recommend that. {M#His}{F#Her} mental state is unstable, so we have to avoid any *rough* traversal methods like just now.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Also, while we're departing, we can still do more for Miss Firefly, can't we? Some remnants of her presence linger nearby. Seize the chance to etch them into your "Remembrance" before they're gone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...If we can start investigating on the way, that'd be good.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Let's go. We have to find another path...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Sorry, but could you give me a few more minutes?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I... have some unfinished business.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Miss Black Swan, the Express is willing to cooperate with you — we need a proper guide to navigate the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm at your service. I will not disappoint.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: [Trailblazer] and March, return to your own rooms. Enter the dream, and if everything goes without a hitch... we'll see one another at the dreamscape Hotel's lobby.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'll stay in the real world to ensure everyone's safety. If needed, I will also parlay with The Family. I assume there's no problem, Miss Black Swan?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It seems that I'll have a hard time gaining your trust even if I personally did rescue your friends... It's no problem, of course, other than the fact that my feelings are a little hurt.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We're counting on you, Welt. As for us... Let's get ready to see the Dreamscape's true visage.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...How do you see things, Himeko?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's best to be skeptical of her. There's a significant amount of intentional misdirection in her words.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But I worry about the worst outcome: If the Dreamscape's anomaly really exists, and it isn't a natural occurrence, but instigated by someone behind the scenes...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Then it likely has something to do with the Watchmaker's invite.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Huh, how'd you figure that one out?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, excluding any extreme scenarios, the mastermind responsible for these shifts in the dreamscape undeniably stands against The Family, which narrows it down to two possibilities...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Someone is drawing in external influences to distract and disrupt The Family's control over Penacony. Either that, or The Family has been forced to seek outside aid surreptitiously for self-preservation.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But from the encrypted message on the invite, and The Family's reaction... The former is more likely.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Which also means that, the one who sent out the encrypted Nameless message and the mastermind behind the anomaly are on the same side... Maybe even the same person.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Well... this doesn't necessarily mean a thing, right? In terms of methods, both the Fools and the Riddlers could pull it off. Hasn't the IPC cracked the message, too?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March, calm down. It's just a possibility. But if this encrypted message isn't some harmless prank, but done so to invite the Trailblaze into the fray, we cannot remain uninvolved.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Well, let me tell you what I discovered, and I'm sorry — it's bad news.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: According to reliable sources, some people spotted a tall silver-armored man on Penacony. I've reached out to the Bloodhound Family for news, and visited many of those guests who claimed to have seen this invader...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...And this is what I received. [Trailblazer], I've sent it to you. Open it and take a look.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: So, the one who attacked you was a girl dressed in red, adept at illusory arts, and was able to shapeshift...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Her name is Sparkle, a Masked Fool who has infiltrated Penacony... Don't worry. She won't be bothering you for now. She's probably patting herself on the back for a job well done.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It seems you know her well.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Of course, I know everyone here. On Penacony, anyone could be lying... but the Remembrance does not lie.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: So I feel the need to clarify with everyone: Miss Sparkle's tricks can induce hallucinations, but that strange Dreamscape? Nothing to do with her — it originated from Penacony itself.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Penacony... itself?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Have you not sensed it yet? This apparent land of dreams... It's a carefully designed dream maintained by The Family through unknown means.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: And the Memory Zone {M#he}{F#she} fell into, that's the true Dreamscape: Chaotic, dangerous, enigmatic... A {RUBY_B#Memory Zone Meme}beast{RUBY_E#} of memory dwells in the ever-shifting labyrinth...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...She's right. Everyone, do you all still remember your surroundings during your entry into the Dreamscape?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Huh, so everyone saw the same thing? I remember... it was a room, and then through a mirror, I came to a long hallway...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Gallery of Thoughts — that's how the hotel staff referred to it.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Have you noticed? These landscapes seem quite distinct from that of Penacony's in your dream, yet strikingly similar to the Dreamscape described by Miss Black Swan.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You're right... I didn't give it much thought at first, but in hindsight, the overlap is hard to ignore.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Also, after speaking to some of the frequenters, the first stop when you enter the dream is supposed to be the hotel in the dream, but due to certain incidents... the hotel is now under renovation.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What could possibly have to happen to an entire building for it to require renovation? Combine that with what {M#he}{F#she} just experienced, and the answer is clear.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hmm, suspicious... Could it really just be a coincidence? I've got a funny feeling about that lady.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But she did find [Trailblazer], and save {M#him}{F#her} too. The least we could do is to listen to the other party's request...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That Memokeeper obviously came here with an agenda. We should remain vigilant.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This way, darling.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: These poor little things stumbling about...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Strange, there appears to be someone else's presence here...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Ah... Her? How is this possible?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We've arrived. There's an elevator here, just like in the lobby. We should be able to reach our destination with it.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But the Memory Zone up ahead... appears to be severely twisted. Be careful, everyone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...See, I told you it wasn't going to be that simple. Where is this?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hurry, through here.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Watch out! A dangerous presence lurks nearby.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Everyone, be on your guard.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...It worked. You really can walk up walls.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: A Memory Zone of this level is mere child's play to a Memokeeper. Come on. Let's head out through the front door.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: This is... a dead end.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You're a natural, aren't you? You're a prodigy at Remembrance, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I have this right... Don't I...
I... won't give up...
Watchmaker's Legacy...
There's no time. I'll just have to break the rules and use some methods to help you phase through the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I picked up slivers of her thoughts in the Memory Zone. These will help you form an impression of her. Now, you must hang on to these thoughts with all your might, and shape them in your mind.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I caught some very familiar memories just now — she's not the only *old friend* who has appeared here. There was also a third party at the scene when you ran into danger...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...That Memory Zone meme, it is here as well.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Yeah. Miss Himeko said that they were investigating the incidents happening in the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, not exactly. Miss Himeko said that they were investigating the incidents happening in the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So, [Trailblazer], how did you end up there... and what the heck happened?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: [Trailblazer], look at me... Calm down, deep breaths, all right?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I'm really sorry, but I have to leave for a short while... Death still hovers about, and I must personally ensure Miss Himeko and Miss March 7th's safety, and warn them...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But if in that moment, I chose to draw my blade...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Yes... Yes, we will. But not yet. Before The Hunt, we should keep our eyes peeled and consider where the true enemies are hiding, and how to fight them...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I understand your anger, and I will accept it... but this isn't the time. We should keep our eyes peeled and consider where the true enemies are hiding, and how to fight them...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Do not let pain dictate your thoughts, [Trailblazer]. Compose yourself, and you will walk the right path.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Look, Miss Himeko: I brought the kid back as promised.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you're all right! We couldn't find you in either dream or reality, we were worried sick...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's good to see you're unharmed. Allow me to introduce you to Miss Black Swan, Memokeeper of the Garden of Recollection.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We've only met once. But thanks to you, we might be able to use this opportunity to get to know each other a little bit better.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Not quite yet. But thanks to you, we might be able to use this opportunity to get to know each other a little bit better.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Penacony's dream is *sinking* right now, turning back to its original form... and falling into the {RUBY_B#Memory Zone}deep sea{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Sinking? You mean... the Dreamscape is collapsing?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The encounter at the dreamscape Hotel was a sign.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...I see. That would explain the uneasiness we've sensed from The Family.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Leaving aside the question of guest safety, were this to become public, it would tarnish the name of the Planet of Festivities. With the Charmony Festival around the corner, it's no wonder they'd want to keep it under wraps.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Even the guests' safety cannot be assured now... Isn't the monster that {M#he}{F#she} encountered indisputable proof? Need I remind you that it is a Memory Zone meme...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: How could a meme that heralds death and murder appear in a dream that The Family proclaims "to be absolutely safe"... Everyone could be lying on Penacony — does that include The Family as well?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Miss Black Swan, we fully understand our current predicament now. Going back to your original suggestion...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: For what reason has the Garden of Recollection chosen to work with the Astral Express?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hmm, let me rephrase then... this is my personal request, not the Garden of Recollection's. And the answer is simple. Miss Himeko, I simply wish to make an exchange... related to the Remembrance.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Apart from my duty, I also have some... personal pursuit in aesthetics. I am a Memokeeper, and a collector. I, too yearn to experience those luminous, dazzling, cherished memories. That's simple enough to understand, no?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: As for you all, Nameless of the Astral Express, and practitioners of the Trailblaze... I have faith in your potential, as well as in the... unique splendor you will unleash on the stage.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: This is why I wish to befriend all of you. A place where nightmares and sweet dreams intersect... the perfect cradle for the Remembrance.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...I understand. But before replying, we must first discuss this among ourselves.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Naturally, take your time.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you... you all right?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Allow me. Relax, you'll be fine.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'll leave [Trailblazer] to you... Miss Acheron.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'm sorry for what happened... I was too focused on that girl, and got sloppy...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It was my hesitation that caused her to lose her life... I'm sorry, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Sorry, I... had no choice.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Once, someone said to me: "No compassion for the enemy, for that is cruelty upon yourself. But you must see clearly who the true enemy is..."
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...And then, with one swing of your blade, you must understand its meaning and the price you pay.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This is the only advice I have for you, from someone burdened with a blood debt.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...I'm back.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: [Trailblazer], Miss Himeko has something to tell you... There's good news, and bad news.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You watch as Acheron turns away. You remember that it was there that she dissolved into a mere illusion.
You see her pause, lips pursed, eyes downcast. After a moment, she hunches down, as if gathering something with her hands, and rises again.
May death be the end of your boundless dream...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Guiding you back... to the waking world.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Right below?
Doesn't look like there's a way down.
Are you going to teach me to phase through walls now?
A half-faded cell phone lies on the floor, capturing an unsent message... with a snapshot of two people wearing smiles.
(You pick it up)
The cell phone has completely dissipated into a dream bubble.
These are all... charred remains?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: They're still smoldering — the culprit can't have gotten far.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I suppose we can slow down for now then...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The remains of this creature bears narrow and deep incisions, with evident traces of charring inflicted by intense burning. A few sparks dance and flicker within, resembling shattered stars departing towards {RUBY_B#Aeon of Nihility}IX{RUBY_E#}.
(Looks like this monster was slain by a thermic weapon...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The remains of this creature, pierced by an unknown weapon, reveal inner tissues that have been seemingly evaporated rapidly due to intense heat. You cannot approach any closer — the steam escaping from the shattered body would undoubtedly scorch you.
(Looks like this monster died of a hyperthermic reaction...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The surface of this creature's remains appears unremarkable. Yet, as your hand grazes it, the searing heat transferred to your fingertips sends you jolting back, as if struck by an electric shock.
Without a doubt, a fierce inferno rages within the remains, desperately longing to break free from its confines. For the sake of your safety, it is best to keep your distance.
This is truly... a magnificent sight. It's this room, then?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Yes. More precisely, it's right below.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Exactly what it means: Down.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You two may not be able to phase through physical structures like Memokeepers, but I've got a great idea that will let you safely reach the floor right below this room.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I wouldn't call it a shortcut if there was.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You two may not be able to phase through physical structures like Memokeepers, but I've got a great idea that will help you safely reach the floor right below this room.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You two may not be able to phase through physical structures like Memokeepers, but I've got a great idea that will help you safely reach the floor right below this room.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's really easy — see this chandelier? Next... we want to create some reasonably *small movements*.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Something's off. These traces are fresh. Someone just left the scene... Would this person have anything to do with what happened just now?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I cannot reach a conclusion with so few clues.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Just listen to your gut — you were the one who said that... the Remembrance doesn't lie.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: From the memories of these carcasses... that person was tall, and much stronger than an adult male. The method was clean and crisp, all one-strike kills — maybe a mercenary, or an assassin.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: He entered through the door from the lobby, and went farther into the hotel. If that's the case... he should have seen everything that happened here...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...I take back what I said. We have to hurry to that Memory Zone where Miss Firefly's presence was imprinted. Considering what this person can do...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: If his goal is that place as well, there won't be anything left there.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Are you ready? Don't be too surprised.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Is that... Firefly?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Yes. It's what this room left behind — the memories of her. The slight trembling of the ground, the fleeting reflections on the screen, the flow of memoria... I gathered and reproduced them in fragments.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: As for the context... we'll need to sort that out a bit. Hurry along now. Recreating memories on this scale takes quite a toll on me.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: If I could try again...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: She stares at the screens. Is she looking at herself in the mirror? ...What does she mean by "try again"?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Calm down, Firefly... Stay calm...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: She seems... very nervous.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Yes. What is making her so nervous?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Let's get going...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: "Let's"? Is there someone else?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That thing I encountered with [Trailblazer] back then...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: If I'm not wrong... it has to do with the Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: She mentioned your name.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Thinking of you even in your absence, seems like you two were pretty close.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: She seems to be sharing her discovery with someone, and... it's related to the Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: She has no idea that she'll become a victim...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The situation has changed, and it seems that companion... has deviated from the original plan.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Perhaps, judging from the outcome... this is that person's true intention.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Who forced her to go that way? And...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: "Mecha"... What an intriguing statement. I recall the Bloodhound family is pursuing a criminal — "a tall male in silver armor."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The door... It won't open... It's a dead end...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Based on these fragmented pieces of information, it seems Firefly's companion betrayed her halfway and trapped her alone in this room, disappearing without a trace... But why?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: She mentioned that this transaction involves the Watchmaker, and that often means stepping on many people's toes.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: They might have had their eyes on the legacy, or wanted to silence another who knew too much. Or, there could be a deeper secret tucked away in this Memory Zone, and to hook that elusive prize... one needs the right bait.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Do you mean... Firefly?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This is just the worst-case scenario. But think about it: If the mastermind behind all this is nearby, why would he let us look around freely? Unless...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...there is something else he cares more about and needs — or should I say, is verifying.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: She thought she had escaped but...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: (Acheron is the Emanator of a particular Aeon? Can I really believe Aventurine...?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (But he gave me a choice... Maybe I should talk to Black Swan again.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Thank you for your efforts, Memokeeper - quite a brilliant move to pit enemies against each other.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: When I first saw the Ranger and the Hunter together, my heart skipped a beat... I never thought you'd successfully trigger a conflict between the two.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: As promised, I've delivered the child to you. Our transaction is complete.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: What is happening...
You two are in this together...
Black Swan, you...
Haha, looks like our Nameless friend over here is still confused. Let me explain.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: In short, you need to thank this lady here, my friend. Not only did she not betray you — on the contrary, she rescued you...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...from that "Galaxy Ranger."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Once you're back in the real world, remember to tell everyone —
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: About the Stellaron Hunter who was behind your ultimate departure.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: My, my... you look like a small injured animal. Are you still willing to talk to me? Of course... I'm still willing to be your psychotherapist.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You betrayed me?
Can I trust Aventurine?
Who do you think is the mastermind...?
Are you willing to bring me out of this Memory Zone?
I admit I'd made a transaction with that gentleman to bring you before him. But... this is also a safe place.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: He needs you. It's essential if we want to reclaim Penacony. Recognizing his immense potential and the invaluable memories he can help me gather, I opted to join forces with him.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: In Penacony, everyone may be lying, and yes... that includes me. I can't deny this, nor do I seek forgiveness.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But do you still remember? I said... "I have faith in your potential," and that's not a lie.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The Garden of Recollection wants to witness the future of the Astral Express Trailblazing the cosmos, and as for these memories — I will treasure them. I do not have reasons to hurt any of you. Instead, I will continue to assist you — provided you are willing to accept my assistance.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: My take on this might surprise you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: In my view, he's a trustworthy individual. Not for any other reason, but because he's an exceptional businessman. In this vast universe, no one values honesty and contracts more than a merchant.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But, always be on guard, particularly when making agreements with him. Scrutinize the details. Beyond the confines of the contract, your rights are off his radar... He'll go to extreme lengths to ensure his advantage.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I still believe that Miss Firefly's situation... is deeply connected with the Stellaron Hunter, just as we speculated. But as you've heard, Aventurine has his finger pointed at the Galaxy Ranger.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I can't fathom why he'd draw that conclusion, but given his access to the IPC's intelligence network, we should seriously consider his perspective. Moreover, I believe Miss Acheron is also hiding something.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...No, in fact, I should say, she's hiding everything from us.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It was an unexpected finding from an earlier encounter. With regards to the Annihilation Gang... I can also prove that what Aventurine said was the truth.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That's why, during this golden soirée... she is the dance's centerpiece.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Why of course, but now's not the time.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I know you're confused and... sad. Whoever that girl might have been, a living soul, a "memory" that was meant to last... she simply vanished, like the dissolution of bubbles in water, disappearing in an instant...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: No matter what, I hope you can trust Aventurine — or rather — trust me and see the "truth" with your own eyes. This can lead us deeper into the secrets behind Penacony.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I will protect you. Once I gather more information from him, I'll make sure you're safely returned to your companions.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: For the truth and to prevent more unnecessary sacrifices... It is the right choice.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You're right. Let's go.
How would I know you're not trying to frame me?
Perhaps he plans on doing so, but I won't.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The Garden of Recollection has eyes everywhere. If he wants to hurt you, he'll have to fight against the Memokeepers — I've warned him about that.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Later, I'll stay by your side as a memetic entity, just in case. Time to set off, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Excellent, I knew you would come. By the way, about that Memokeeper... Never mind, I won't press the issue further.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I've said before, you can liaise with your companions, or even twist the narrative against me. I'll wholeheartedly embrace it! It signifies your potential.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I don't do deals where I'm on the losing end. So, my "friends"... don't let me down.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Please, this way if you will!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Are you still... continuing down this path? This is a rare opportunity. Leaving here... will also mean leaving the truth.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I've decided. I'm leaving this place.
You're right. I can't leave.

Aventurine isn't here. You know that, and so does he. You can also choose to turn around and find out what the facts are directly from his mouth, but if you insist on going forward, that signals a "rejection."
Leave directly.
Let's go back and find Aventurine...
Yes, I better think about Aventurine's proposal.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I see... Fine, I respect your choice. Let's return to reality.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: After careful consideration, you decline Aventurine's invitation. This time, he simply watches as you depart from the Memory Zone without asking you to stay.
Returning to reality, you reunite with your companions. After a thorough discussion, the Crew decides to assist Penacony, leading to the revelation of a conspiracy orchestrated by the IPC.

With the expulsion of all ill-intentioned visitors, the Charmony Festival proceeds smoothly. As honored guests, you partake in the joyous atmosphere, filled with laughter, clinking glasses full of SoulGlad, and the exuberant singing and dancing of the crowd...
"May this moment last forever, and may we never awaken from this euphoric dream!"

rows.text: (Enter the room.)
Oh, I remember... my friend! After that, we played an enjoyable game.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Tell me, doesn't this feel eerily familiar?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I remember everything now. This was what I told you at that time...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...What's going on? Why is it... getting hot in the memoria?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You've noticed it too. Like something is burning...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Look... Upon leaving the lobby, the structure has become chaotic. Phase through that corridor, and be careful — do not alert the meme.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Why did you...!? This isn't what we agreed on...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Mecha...!? Why...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: There's actually a path here...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Unpredictable pathways pointing toward a wandering meme... She was completely lost in the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's an exit... Following this path should lead me out of this place...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Unfortunately, this path ultimately leads one to the lair of "Death."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Finally back at the lobby. If that's the case...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: She thought she had escaped but...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The door... It won't open...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: She had no other way to leave but from the side corridor.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: After that, it's the end...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Everyone, over there—
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It seems like someone has been awaiting us. Ready to step into the spotlight now?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Stellaron Hunter: Sam.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: (Go and meet Aventurine, or... I could still choose not to help...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Oh right, I remember mentioning something after that... What was it again?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Ah... a familiar hallway, a familiar room. Do you remember? The last time we met was right here.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Look, a solitary chain. Go say hello to it.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Still remember what I taught you? Feel the flow of the memoria, walk up the wall, and then... get close to it.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But? There's no but. This is the truth.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Perhaps The Hunt... or Destruction... or even Finality. It doesn't matter, these Paths all point to the same outcome.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: She was there? Wait, what... You're kidding... Oh my, this just got even more interesting.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Let me give you some IPC insider information, my friend. Do you know "Duke Inferno" — Fetora's Ifrit?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This Duke Inferno is a Fire Demon from Fetora. He's an energy lifeform, and it's rumored that his birth is related to a certain genius...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: They were eliminated while on their way. The assailant, demonstrating remarkable expertise, ruthlessly ended Ifrit and swiped the invite that the Annihilation Gang had in their possession. The Ever-Flame Mansion disbanded, each going their separate ways...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The Galaxy Rangers come and go like shadows, and there's little communication between them. Her story is almost too perfect. If she remains silent, there's no concrete evidence against her. While the IPC can investigate, it'll take some time.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Nicely done, as expected! I'll cut to the chase then...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You don't seem to have heard of him before... He belongs to the Annihilation Gang, so I guess it's normal. Then let me explain to you...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Look, it's common sense and easy, right?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Are we... jumping down from here?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Don't worry, I'll do something about it. Let me stack the dream bubbles to give everyone a nice, soft landing.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Okay, here we go...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We landed safely. This is... amazing.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Don't imitate the Memokeeper without the accompaniment of one! Well...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...wouldn't it be lovely if these nosy newcomers found their way back home?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Right, I do enjoy seeing that shocked expression of yours.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: My friend, let's be honest. That woman named "Acheron" isn't as simple as you thought. Did she say she's a Galaxy Ranger?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...She's actually an Emanator, who brings death and finality.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: He and his thugs formed "Ever-Flame Mansion" and viewed Nanook as their savior — in actuality, they were led by this duke to go around burning and looting, practicing the will of Destruction. And even the other Annihilation Gangs weren't spared.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'm not sure what The Family was thinking, or perhaps someone was scheming behind the scenes, but shockingly these characters received an invitation. And why would the Ever-Flame Mansion decline? They harbor fierce intentions, swearing to turn the Planet of Festivities into a sea of blazing flames...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But there's no need to worry. They won't be able to attend. Do you know why?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Because Ifrit is dead.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Thereafter, a mysterious Galaxy Ranger arrived on Penacony, checking into the hotel with only a music box... Do you still need me to continue the story, my friend?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: So, my friend, the choice is yours now... You can leave this place immediately, without looking back, and forever forsake the chance to get closer to the truth.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Or, you can accept my invitation and learn a truth, a truth potent enough to upend everything in Penacony.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I need your help, so I'll wait — but not for long. Once you are ready... follow me.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: As for aligning with me, see the truth first, then decide... you'll still have time.
rows.speaker: Aventurine
